bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 春，二月，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 民訛言黃龍墮死黃山宮中，百姓奔走往觀者有萬數。

translations.literal: Among the people a rumor spread that a yellow dragon had fallen dead in Huangshan Palace; commoners who ran to see it numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: A rumor spread among the people that a yellow dragon had fallen dead in Huangshan Palace; tens of thousands of commoners ran to see it.

sentences.zh: 莽惡之，捕繫，問語所從起，不能得。

translations.literal: Mang hated it, arrested and imprisoned them, questioned whence the talk arose, and could not find out.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang hated it, had people arrested and imprisoned, questioned whence the talk arose, and could not find out.

sentences.zh: 單于咸既和親，求其子登屍。

translations.literal: The Chanyu Xian, having made peace through marriage alliance, asked for the corpse of his son Deng.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu Xian, having made peace through marriage alliance, asked for the corpse of his son Deng.

sentences.zh: 莽欲遣使送致，恐咸怨恨，害使者，乃收前言當誅侍子者故將軍陳欽，以他罪殺之。

translations.literal: Mang wished to send envoys to deliver him, but feared Xian would resent it and harm the envoys; he therefore seized the former general Chen Qin, who earlier had said the hostage prince ought to be executed, and killed him on another charge.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang wished to send envoys to deliver the body, but feared Xian would resent it and harm the envoys; he therefore seized the former general Chen Qin, who earlier had said the hostage prince ought to be executed, and killed him on another charge.

sentences.zh: 莽選辯士濟南王咸為大使。

translations.literal: Mang selected the eloquent Wang Xian, Prince of Jinan, as chief envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang selected the eloquent Wang Xian, Prince of Jinan, as chief envoy.

sentences.zh: 夏，五月，莽復遣和親侯歙與咸等送右廚唯姑夕王，因奉歸前所斬侍子登及諸貴人從者喪。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Mang again sent Heqin Marquis She with Xian and others to escort the King of Youchu Weigu Xi, and thereby return the remains of the hostage prince Deng previously executed and of the noble attendants who had followed him.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, Wang Mang again sent Heqin Marquis She with Xian and others to escort the King of Youchu Weigu Xi, and thereby return the remains of the hostage prince Deng previously executed and of the noble attendants who had followed him.

sentences.zh: 單于遣雲、當子男大且渠奢等至塞迎之。

translations.literal: The Chanyu sent Yun, Dang's son the younger lord Da Qiequ She, and others to the frontier to welcome them.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu sent Yun, Dang's son the younger lord Da Qiequ She, and others to the frontier to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 咸到單于庭，陳莽威德，莽亦多遺單于金珍，因諭說改其號，號匈奴曰「恭奴」，單于曰「善於」，賜印綬，封骨都侯當為後安公，當子男奢為後安侯。

translations.literal: When Xian reached the Chanyu's court he set forth Mang's might and virtue; Mang also sent the Chanyu many gold treasures and thereby urged changing his titles—calling the Xiongnu "Gongnu," the Chanyu "Shanyu"—and granted seals and ribbons, enfeoffing Gudu Hou Dang as Duke Hou'an and Dang's son the younger lord She as Marquis Hou'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian reached the Chanyu's court he set forth Wang Mang's might and virtue; Wang Mang also sent the Chanyu many gold treasures and urged changing his titles—calling the Xiongnu "Gongnu" and the Chanyu "Shanyu"—granted seals and ribbons, enfeoffed Gudu Hou Dang as Duke Hou'an, and Dang's son the younger lord She as Marquis Hou'an.

sentences.zh: 單于貪莽金幣，故曲聽之，然寇盜如故。

translations.literal: The Chanyu, greedy for Mang's gold and coin, therefore bent his ear to it, yet raiding and plunder continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Chanyu, greedy for Wang Mang's gold and coin, bent his ear to it, yet raiding and plunder continued as before.

sentences.zh: 莽意以為制定則天下自平，故銳思於地理，制禮，作樂，講合《六經》之說。

translations.literal: Mang's mind held that once institutions were fixed the realm would of itself be tranquil; therefore he keenly applied thought to territorial divisions, fashioned ritual, composed music, and lectured to harmonize the doctrines of the Six Classics.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang believed that once institutions were fixed the realm would of itself be tranquil; therefore he keenly applied thought to territorial divisions, fashioned ritual, composed music, and lectured to harmonize the doctrines of the Six Classics.

sentences.zh: 公卿旦入暮出，論議連年不決，不暇省獄訟冤結，民之急務。

translations.literal: Dukes and ministers entered at dawn and left at dusk; deliberations went on for years without decision, with no leisure to review prison cases and knotted grievances—the people's urgent affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes and ministers entered at dawn and left at dusk; deliberations went on for years without decision, with no leisure to review prison cases and knotted grievances—the people's urgent affairs.

sentences.zh: 縣宰缺者數年守兼，一切貪殘日甚。

translations.literal: Where magistrates were vacant, for years administrators held posts concurrently; everywhere greed and cruelty grew daily worse.
translations.idiomatic: Where magistrates were vacant, for years administrators held posts concurrently; everywhere greed and cruelty grew daily worse.

sentences.zh: 中郎將、繡衣執法在郡國者，並乘權勢，傳相舉奏。

translations.literal: Masters of the Palace Guard and embroidered-cloak law enforcers in the commanderies and kingdoms all rode their power, passing reports and impeaching one another.
translations.idiomatic: Masters of the Palace Guard and embroidered-cloak law enforcers in the commanderies and kingdoms all rode their power, passing reports and impeaching one another.

sentences.zh: 又十一公士分佈勸農桑，班時令，按諸章，冠蓋相望，交錯道路，召會吏民，逮捕證左，郡縣賦斂，遞相賕賂，白黑紛然，守闕告訴者多。

translations.literal: Again the eleven dukes' scholars were distributed to urge agriculture and sericulture, promulgate seasonal orders, and inspect the various regulations—carriages and canopies in sight of one another, crisscrossing the roads; they summoned officials and people, arrested witnesses, commanderies and counties levied taxes, bribes passed hand to hand, right and wrong tangled, and many waited at the palace gates to lodge complaints.
translations.idiomatic: Again the eleven dukes' scholars were distributed to urge agriculture and sericulture, promulgate seasonal orders, and inspect the various regulations—carriages and canopies in sight of one another, crisscrossing the roads; they summoned officials and people, arrested witnesses, commanderies and counties levied taxes, bribes passed hand to hand, right and wrong tangled, and many waited at the palace gates to lodge complaints.

sentences.zh: 莽自見前顓權以得漢政，故務自攬眾事，有司受成苟免。

translations.literal: Mang himself saw that formerly he had monopolized power to seize Han government; therefore he strove to gather all affairs to himself, and responsible offices merely received completed work and sought to escape blame.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang himself saw that formerly he had monopolized power to seize Han government; therefore he strove to gather all affairs to himself, and responsible offices merely received completed work and sought to escape blame.

sentences.zh: 諸寶物名、帑藏、錢穀官皆宦者領之；

translations.literal: All offices for precious objects, treasury stores, and cash and grain were led by eunuchs;
translations.idiomatic: all offices for precious objects, treasury stores, and cash and grain were led by eunuchs;

sentences.zh: 吏民上封事，宦官、左右開發，尚書不得知。

translations.literal: when officials and people submitted sealed memorials, eunuchs and attendants opened and developed them—the Masters of Writing could not know.
translations.idiomatic: when officials and people submitted sealed memorials, eunuchs and attendants opened them—the Masters of Writing could not know.

sentences.zh: 其畏備臣下如此。

translations.literal: His fear and guard against subordinates were to this degree.
translations.idiomatic: His fear and guard against subordinates were to this degree.

sentences.zh: 又好變改制度，政令煩多，當奉行者，輒質問乃以從事，前後相乘，憒眊不渫。

translations.literal: He also loved changing institutions; government orders were numerous and vexing; what ought to be carried out was first questioned before being implemented—one upon another, confusion and muddle without relief.
translations.idiomatic: He also loved changing institutions; government orders were numerous and vexing; what ought to be carried out was first questioned before being implemented—layer upon layer, confusion and muddle without relief.

sentences.zh: 莽常御燈火至明，猶不能勝。

translations.literal: Mang often attended to lamp and flame until dawn and still could not master it.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang often worked by lamp and flame until dawn and still could not master it.

sentences.zh: 尚書因是為奸，寢事，上書待報者連年不得去，拘繫郡縣者逢赦而後出，衛卒不交代者至三歲。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing therefore committed treachery and neglected affairs; those who submitted memorials awaiting reply could not leave for years; those imprisoned in commanderies and counties came out only when an amnesty came; palace guards who did not hand over duty reached three years.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing therefore committed treachery and neglected affairs; those who submitted memorials awaiting reply could not leave for years; those imprisoned in commanderies and counties came out only when an amnesty came; palace guards who did not hand over duty reached three years.

sentences.zh: 穀糴常貴，邊兵二十餘萬人，仰衣食縣官。

translations.literal: Grain and provisions were constantly dear; frontier troops, more than two hundred thousand men, looked up for food and clothing to the county offices.
translations.idiomatic: Grain and provisions were constantly dear; more than two hundred thousand frontier troops looked to the county offices for food and clothing.

sentences.zh: 五原、代郡尤被其毒，起為盜賊，數千人為輩，轉入旁郡。

translations.literal: Wuyuan and Dai commanderies especially suffered this poison; they rose as bandits, several thousand men forming bands, and shifted into neighboring commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyuan and Dai commanderies especially suffered this poison; they rose as bandits, several thousand men forming bands, and shifted into neighboring commanderies.

sentences.zh: 莽遣捕盜將軍孔仁將兵與郡縣合擊，歲餘乃定。

translations.literal: Mang sent Bandit-Capturing General Kong Ren to lead troops and join commanderies and counties in striking them; after more than a year it was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent Bandit-Capturing General Kong Ren to lead troops and join commanderies and counties in striking them; after more than a year it was settled.

sentences.zh: 邯鄲以北大雨，水出，深者數丈，流殺數千人。

translations.literal: North of Handan heavy rain fell; water burst forth, in deep places several zhang, and the current killed several thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: North of Handan heavy rain fell; water burst forth—in deep places several zhang—and the current killed several thousand people.

sentences.zh: 春，二月，乙酉，地震，大雨雪；

translations.literal: In spring, the second month, on yiyou day there was an earthquake and heavy rain with snow;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the second month, on yiyou day there was an earthquake and heavy rain with snow;

sentences.zh: 關東尤甚，深者一丈，竹柏或枯。

translations.literal: east of the passes it was especially severe—depth in places one zhang; bamboo and cypress in places withered.
translations.idiomatic: east of the passes it was especially severe—depth in places one zhang; bamboo and cypress in places withered.

sentences.zh: 大司空王邑上書，以地震乞骸骨。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi submitted a memorial, citing the earthquake to beg his bones.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi submitted a memorial, citing the earthquake to request retirement.

sentences.zh: 莽不許，曰：「夫地有動有震，震者有害，動者不害。

translations.literal: Mang did not permit it and said: "The earth has movement and quaking; quaking is harmful, movement is not harmful.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang did not permit it and said, "The earth has movement and quaking; quaking is harmful, movement is not harmful.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》記地震，《易‧系》坤動。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals records earthquakes; the Yi, Xi commentary says Kun moves.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals records earthquakes; the Yi, Xi commentary says Kun moves.

sentences.zh: 動靜辟翕，萬物生焉。

translations.literal: Movement and stillness open and close; the ten thousand things are born thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Movement and stillness open and close; the ten thousand things are born thereby.

sentences.zh: 」其好自誣飾，皆此類也。

translations.literal: " His love of self-deception and ornament were all of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: " His love of self-deception and ornament were all of this sort.

sentences.zh: 先是，莽以製作未定，上自公侯，下至小吏，皆不得俸祿。

translations.literal: Earlier, because Mang's creations were not fixed, from dukes and marquises down to petty clerks, none received salary.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, because Wang Mang's creations were not fixed, from dukes and marquises down to petty clerks, none received salary.

sentences.zh: 夏，五月，莽下書曰：「予遭陽九之厄，百六之會，國用不足，民人騷動，自公卿以下，一月之祿十稯布二匹，或帛一匹。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Mang issued a document saying: "I have encountered the calamity of Yang Nine and the conjunction of One Hundred Six; state expenditure is insufficient and the people are in turmoil; from dukes and ministers down, one month's salary is ten pecks of grain and two bolts of cloth, or one bolt of silk.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, Wang Mang issued a document saying, "I have encountered the calamity of Yang Nine and the conjunction of One Hundred Six; state expenditure is insufficient and the people are in turmoil; from dukes and ministers down, one month's salary is ten pecks of grain and two bolts of cloth, or one bolt of silk.

sentences.zh: 予每念之，未嘗不戚焉。

translations.literal: Whenever I think on it, I have never failed to grieve.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I think on it, I have never failed to grieve.

sentences.zh: 今厄會已度，府帑雖未能充，略頗稍給。

translations.literal: Now the calamity and conjunction have passed; though the treasury cannot yet be filled, it is somewhat supplied in part.
translations.idiomatic: Now the calamity and conjunction have passed; though the treasury cannot yet be filled, it is somewhat supplied in part.

sentences.zh: 其以六月朔庚寅始，賦吏祿皆如制度。

translations.literal: Let it begin from the new moon of the sixth month, gengyin day—grant officials' salaries all according to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Let it begin from the new moon of the sixth month, gengyin day—grant officials' salaries all according to the regulations.

sentences.zh: 」四輔、公卿、大夫、士下至輿、僚，凡十五等。

translations.literal: " The Four Assistants, dukes and ministers, grandees, and scholars down to carriage attendants and aides—fifteen grades in all.
translations.idiomatic: " The Four Assistants, dukes and ministers, grandees, and scholars down to carriage attendants and aides—fifteen grades in all.

sentences.zh: 僚祿一歲六十六斛，稍以差增。

translations.literal: Aides' salary was sixty-six hu per year, increasing by slight steps of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Aides' salary was sixty-six hu per year, increasing by slight steps of rank.

sentences.zh: 上至四輔而為萬斛云。

translations.literal: Up to the Four Assistants it reached ten thousand hu, it is said.
translations.idiomatic: Up to the Four Assistants it reached ten thousand hu, it is said.

sentences.zh: 莽又曰：「古者歲豐穰則充其禮，有災害則有所損，與百姓同憂喜也。

translations.literal: Mang also said: "In antiquity when the year was rich and abundant they fulfilled their ritual; when there were disasters they made reductions—sharing worry and joy with the hundred surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang also said, "In antiquity when the year was rich and abundant they fulfilled their ritual; when there were disasters they made reductions—sharing worry and joy with the hundred surnames.

sentences.zh: 其用上計時通計，天下幸無災害者，太官膳羞備其品矣；

translations.literal: When using the upward reckoning at the time of the general reckoning, if throughout the realm by good fortune there were no disasters, the Grand Provisioner's meals and delicacies would have their full assortment;
translations.idiomatic: When using the upward reckoning at the time of the general reckoning, if throughout the realm by good fortune there were no disasters, the Grand Provisioner's meals and delicacies would have their full assortment;

sentences.zh: 即有災害，以什率多少而損膳焉。

translations.literal: if there were disasters, by the rate of one in ten, more or less, they would reduce the meals.
translations.idiomatic: if there were disasters, by the rate of one in ten, more or less, they would reduce the meals.

sentences.zh: 自十一公、六司、六卿以下，各分州郡、國邑保其災害，亦以十率多少而損其祿。

translations.literal: From the eleven dukes, six directors, and six ministers down, each divided among provinces, commanderies, kingdoms, and districts to guarantee their disasters, likewise by the rate of ten, more or less, reducing their salaries.
translations.idiomatic: From the eleven dukes, six directors, and six ministers down, each divided among provinces, commanderies, kingdoms, and districts to guarantee their disasters, likewise by the rate of ten, more or less, reducing their salaries.

sentences.zh: 郎、從官、中都官吏食祿都內之委者，以太官膳羞備損而為節。

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the palace, attendant officials, and capital officials who ate salaries from the capital's stored provisions were to take the Grand Provisioner's full or reduced meals as their measure.
translations.idiomatic: Gentlemen of the palace, attendant officials, and capital officials who ate salaries from the capital's stored provisions were to take the Grand Provisioner's full or reduced meals as their measure.

sentences.zh: 冀上下同心，勸進農業，安元元焉。

translations.literal: He hoped that above and below would be of one heart, urging advance in agriculture, and settling the masses.
translations.idiomatic: He hoped that above and below would be of one heart, urging advance in agriculture, and settling the masses.

sentences.zh: 」莽之制度煩碎如此，課計不可理，吏終不得祿，各因官職為奸，受取賕賂以自共給焉。

translations.literal: " Mang's institutions were vexing and minute to this degree; the reckoning could not be managed; officials in the end did not receive salary—each according to his office committed treachery, accepting bribes to supply himself.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang's institutions were vexing and minute to this degree; the reckoning could not be managed; officials in the end did not receive salary—each according to his office committed treachery, accepting bribes to supply himself.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，長平館西岸崩，壅涇水不流，毀而北行。

translations.literal: On wuchen day the west bank of Changping Lodge collapsed, damming the Jing River so it did not flow, broke through, and ran north.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the west bank of Changping Lodge collapsed, damming the Jing River so it did not flow, broke through, and ran north.

sentences.zh: 群臣上壽，以為《河圖》所謂「以土填水」，匈奴滅亡之祥也。

translations.literal: The host of ministers offered longevity congratulations, taking it as what the Hetu calls "using earth to fill water"—an omen of the Xiongnu's destruction and perishing.
translations.idiomatic: The host of ministers offered longevity congratulations, taking it as what the Hetu calls "using earth to fill water"—an omen of the Xiongnu's destruction and perishing.

sentences.zh: 莽乃遣并州牧宋弘、游擊都尉任萌等將兵擊匈奴，至邊上屯。

translations.literal: Mang thereupon sent Bingzhou Governor Song Hong, Mobile Cavalry Commandant Ren Meng, and others to lead troops against the Xiongnu; they reached the frontier and encamped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang thereupon sent Bingzhou Governor Song Hong, Mobile Cavalry Commandant Ren Meng, and others to lead troops against the Xiongnu; they reached the frontier and encamped.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，辛酉，霸城門災。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinyou day, Bacheng Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on xinyou day, Bacheng Gate burned.

sentences.zh: 戊子晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, wuzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, wuzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 平蠻將軍馮茂擊句町，士卒疾疫死者什六七，賦斂民財什取五，益州虛耗而不克；

translations.literal: Pacify-the-Barbarians General Feng Mao attacked Juding; of the soldiers, six or seven in ten died of plague; levies took five parts in ten of the people's wealth; Yizhou was drained empty and he could not overcome them;
translations.idiomatic: Pacify-the-Barbarians General Feng Mao attacked Juding; six or seven soldiers in ten died of plague; levies took five parts in ten of the people's wealth; Yizhou was drained empty and he could not overcome them;

sentences.zh: 徵還，下獄死。

translations.literal: he was recalled, cast into prison, and died.
translations.idiomatic: he was recalled, cast into prison, and died.

sentences.zh: 冬，更遣寧始將軍廉丹與庸部牧史熊，大發天水、隴西騎士，廣漢、巴、蜀、犍為吏民十萬人、轉輸者合二十萬人擊之。

translations.literal: In winter he again sent Pacify-Beginnings General Lian Dan and Yong Department Governor Shi Xiong, greatly mobilizing cavalrymen of Tianshui and Longxi, and officials and people of Guanghan, Ba, Shu, and Jianwei—a hundred thousand men, with transport laborers totaling two hundred thousand—to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In winter he again sent Pacify-Beginnings General Lian Dan and Yong Department Governor Shi Xiong, greatly mobilizing cavalrymen of Tianshui and Longxi and officials and people of Guanghan, Ba, Shu, and Jianwei—a hundred thousand men, with transport laborers totaling two hundred thousand—to attack them.

sentences.zh: 始至，頗斬首數千；

translations.literal: At first on arrival they beheaded several thousand;
translations.idiomatic: At first on arrival they beheaded several thousand;

sentences.zh: 其後軍糧前後不相及，士卒饑疫。

translations.literal: afterward army grain before and behind did not connect; soldiers hungered and suffered plague.
translations.idiomatic: afterward army grain before and behind did not connect; soldiers hungered and suffered plague.

sentences.zh: 莽征丹、熊，丹、熊願益調度，必克乃還，復大賦斂。

translations.literal: Mang summoned Dan and Xiong; Dan and Xiong wished to increase allocations, vowing they would return only when they had overcome the enemy, and again levied heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang summoned Dan and Xiong; Dan and Xiong wished to increase allocations, vowing they would return only when they had overcome the enemy, and again levied heavily.

sentences.zh: 就都大尹馮英不肯給，上言：「自西南夷反叛以來，積且十年，郡縣距擊不已。

translations.literal: Capital Metropolitan Governor Feng Ying refused to supply them and submitted a memorial: "Since the southwestern barbarians rebelled, it has piled up to nearly ten years; commanderies and counties resist and strike without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Capital Metropolitan Governor Feng Ying refused to supply them and submitted a memorial: "Since the southwestern barbarians rebelled, it has piled up to nearly ten years; commanderies and counties resist and strike without cease.

sentences.zh: 續用馮茂，苟施一切之政，僰道以南，山險高深，茂多驅眾遠居，費以億計，吏士罹毒氣死者什七。

translations.literal: Continuing with Feng Mao, they hastily applied catch-all policies; south of Baidao the mountains were perilous, steep, and deep—Mao often drove the masses to dwell far away, costs reckoned in the hundreds of millions; of officials and soldiers who suffered miasma, seven in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing with Feng Mao, they hastily applied catch-all policies; south of Baidao the mountains were perilous, steep, and deep—Mao often drove the masses to dwell far away, costs reckoned in the hundreds of millions; of officials and soldiers who suffered miasma, seven in ten died.

sentences.zh: 今丹、熊懼於自詭，期會調發諸郡兵穀，復訾民取其什四，空破梁州，功終不遂。

translations.literal: Now Dan and Xiong, fearing self-exposure, set deadlines to mobilize troops and grain from the commanderies, again assessed the people and took four parts in ten, hollowly breaking Liang province—the achievement in the end would not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Now Dan and Xiong, fearing self-exposure, set deadlines to mobilize troops and grain from the commanderies, again assessed the people and took four parts in ten, hollowly breaking Liang province—the achievement in the end would not succeed.

sentences.zh: 宜罷兵屯田，明設購賞。

translations.literal: It is fitting to halt the troops and garrison fields, clearly setting rewards for capture.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to halt the troops and garrison fields, clearly setting rewards for capture.

sentences.zh: 」莽怒，免英官；

translations.literal: " Mang was angry and removed Ying from office;
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was angry and removed Ying from office;

sentences.zh: 後頗覺寤，曰：「英亦未可厚非。

translations.literal: later he somewhat awakened and said: "Ying also cannot be greatly blamed.
translations.idiomatic: later he somewhat awakened and said, "Ying also cannot be greatly blamed.

sentences.zh: 」復以英為長沙連率。

translations.literal: " He again made Ying Colonel-Linkage of Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: " He again made Ying Colonel-Linkage of Changsha.

sentences.zh: 粵巂蠻夷任貴亦殺太守枚根，自立為邛谷王。

translations.literal: The Yuexi barbarian Ren Gui also killed Administrator Mei Gen and set himself up as King of Qionggu.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuexi barbarian Ren Gui also killed Administrator Mei Gen and set himself up as King of Qionggu.

sentences.zh: 翟義黨王孫慶捕得，莽使太醫、尚方與巧屠共刳剝之，量度五臧，以竹筵導其脈，知所終始，-{云}-可以治病。

translations.literal: Zhai Yi's partisan Wang Sunqing was captured; Mang had the imperial physician, the imperial workshop, and skilled butchers jointly flay and disembowel him, measure the five viscera, guide his pulses with bamboo mats, know their beginning and end—-{云}- could be used to treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Yi's partisan Wang Sunqing was captured; Wang Mang had the imperial physician, the imperial workshop, and skilled butchers jointly flay and disembowel him, measure the five viscera, guide his pulses with bamboo mats, know their beginning and end—-{云}- could be used to treat illness.

sentences.zh: 是歲，遣大使五威將王駿、西域都護李崇、戊己校尉郭欽出西域。

translations.literal: That year he sent Grand Envoy Five-Power General Wang Jun, Protector-General of the Western Regions Li Chong, and Colonel of the Garrison of the Wuji Guo Qin out to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: That year he sent Grand Envoy Five-Power General Wang Jun, Protector-General of the Western Regions Li Chong, and Colonel of the Garrison of the Wuji Guo Qin out to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 諸國皆郊迎，送兵穀。

translations.literal: All the states met them in the suburbs to welcome them and sent troops and grain.
translations.idiomatic: All the states met them in the suburbs to welcome them and sent troops and grain.

sentences.zh: 駿欲襲擊之，焉耆詐降而聚兵自備，駿等將莎車、龜茲兵七千餘人分為數部，命郭欽及佐帥何封別將居後。

translations.literal: Jun wished to strike them; Yanqi feigned surrender while gathering troops to arm itself; Jun and others led more than seven thousand soldiers of Shache and Kucha, divided into several columns, ordering Guo Qin and assistant commander He Feng as separate generals to remain in the rear.
translations.idiomatic: Jun wished to strike them; Yanqi feigned surrender while gathering troops to arm itself; Jun and others led more than seven thousand soldiers of Shache and Kucha, divided into several columns, ordering Guo Qin and assistant commander He Feng as separate generals to remain in the rear.

sentences.zh: 駿等入焉耆，焉耆伏兵要遮駿，及姑墨、封犁、危須國兵為反間，還共襲駿等，皆殺之。

translations.literal: When Jun and others entered Yanqi, Yanqi ambushed troops to intercept Jun; together with the troops of Gumo, Fengli, and Weixu states as a counter-stratagem, they turned back and jointly struck Jun and others—all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: When Jun and others entered Yanqi, Yanqi ambushed troops to intercept Jun; together with the troops of Gumo, Fengli, and Weixu states as a counter-stratagem, they turned back and jointly struck Jun and others—all were killed.

sentences.zh: 欽、封後至焉耆，焉耆兵未還，欽襲擊，殺其老弱，從車師還入塞。

translations.literal: Qin and Feng arrived later at Yanqi; Yanqi's troops had not yet returned; Qin struck suddenly, killed their old and weak, and returned through Jushi to enter the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Feng arrived later at Yanqi; Yanqi's troops had not yet returned; Qin struck suddenly, killed their old and weak, and returned through Jushi to enter the passes.

sentences.zh: 莽拜欽為填外將軍，封劋鬍子；

translations.literal: Mang invested Qin as General Who Fills Beyond and enfeoffed him as Marquis Who Slays the Barbarians;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang invested Qin as General Who Fills Beyond and enfeoffed him as Marquis Who Slays the Barbarians;

sentences.zh: 何封為集胡男。

translations.literal: He Feng as Baron Who Gathers the Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: He Feng as Baron Who Gathers the Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 李崇收餘士，還保龜茲。

translations.literal: Li Chong gathered the remaining soldiers and returned to hold Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong gathered the remaining soldiers and returned to hold Kucha.

sentences.zh: 及莽敗，崇沒，西域遂絕。

translations.literal: When Mang was defeated, Chong perished, and the Western Regions were thereby cut off.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Mang was defeated, Chong perished, and the Western Regions were thereby cut off.

sentences.zh: 夏，六月，莽更授諸侯茅土於明堂，親設文石之平，陳菁茅四色之土，告於岱宗、泰社、后土、先祖、先妣以班授之。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Mang again granted feudatories' thatch and earth in the Bright Hall, personally set the level of patterned stone, displayed azure thatch and earth of four colors, and announced to Mount Dai, the Grand Altar of Earth, Queen Earth, former kings, and former queens to distribute and invest them.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the sixth month, Wang Mang again granted feudatories' thatch and earth in the Bright Hall, personally set the level of patterned stone, displayed azure thatch and earth of four colors, and announced to Mount Dai, the Grand Altar of Earth, Queen Earth, former kings, and former queens to distribute and invest them.

sentences.zh: 莽好空言，慕古法，多封爵人，性實吝嗇，托以地理未定，故且先賦茅土，用慰喜封者。

translations.literal: Mang loved empty words, admired ancient methods, and enfeoffed many men, yet his nature was truly stingy; he pleaded that territorial divisions were not yet fixed, and therefore for the time being first granted thatch and earth to console those pleased by enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang loved empty words, admired ancient methods, and enfeoffed many men, yet his nature was truly stingy; he pleaded that territorial divisions were not yet fixed, and therefore for the time being first granted thatch and earth to console those pleased by enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，莽親之南郊，鑄作威鬥，以五石銅為之，若北斗，長二尺五寸，欲以厭勝眾兵。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Mang personally went to the southern suburb, cast and made a Might Dipper of five-colored copper, like the Northern Dipper, two chi five cun long, wishing thereby to overcome and subdue the host of troops.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, Wang Mang personally went to the southern suburb, cast and made a Might Dipper of five-colored copper, like the Northern Dipper, two chi five cun long, wishing thereby to overcome and subdue the host of troops.

sentences.zh: 既成，令司命負之，莽出在前，入在御旁。

translations.literal: When it was finished he ordered the Director of Destiny to bear it—Mang went out with it before him, entered with it beside the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: When it was finished he ordered the Director of Destiny to bear it—Wang Mang went out with it before him, entered with it beside the carriage.

sentences.zh: 莽置羲和命士，以督五均、六筦。

translations.literal: Mang established Directors of Harmony and Mandate Scholars to oversee the Five Equilibrations and Six Monopolies.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang established Directors of Harmony and Mandate Scholars to oversee the Five Equilibrations and Six Monopolies.

sentences.zh: 郡有數人，皆用富賈為之，乘傳求利，交錯天下。

translations.literal: Each commandery had several men, all appointed from wealthy merchants; they rode relay posts seeking profit, crisscrossing the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Each commandery had several men, all appointed from wealthy merchants; they rode relay posts seeking profit, crisscrossing the realm.

sentences.zh: 因與郡縣通姦，多張空簿，府藏不實，百姓愈病。

translations.literal: They therefore connived with commanderies and counties, often inflating empty ledgers; treasury stores were not real, and the hundred surnames grew ever more afflicted.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore connived with commanderies and counties, often inflating empty ledgers; treasury stores were not real, and the hundred surnames grew ever more afflicted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，莽復下詔申明六筦，每一筦為設科條防禁，犯者罪至死。

translations.literal: That year Mang again issued an edict clarifying the Six Monopolies; for each monopoly he set statutes of prohibition—violators' crime reached death.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wang Mang again issued an edict clarifying the Six Monopolies; for each monopoly he set statutes of prohibition—violators' crime reached death.

sentences.zh: 奸吏猾民並侵，眾庶各不安生，又一切調上公以下諸有奴婢者，率一口出錢三千六百，天下愈愁。

translations.literal: Treacherous officials and cunning commoners encroached together; the multitude each could not settle their lives; again a catch-all levy on all below the upper dukes who had slaves and bondmaids—per mouth three thousand six hundred cash—the realm grew ever more bitter.
translations.idiomatic: Treacherous officials and cunning commoners encroached together; the multitude each could not settle their lives; again a catch-all levy on all below the upper dukes who had slaves and bondmaids—per mouth three thousand six hundred cash—the realm grew ever more bitter.

sentences.zh: 納言馮常以六筦諫，莽大怒，免常官。

translations.literal: Receiver of Words Feng Chang remonstrated regarding the Six Monopolies; Mang was greatly angered and removed Chang from office.
translations.idiomatic: Receiver of Words Feng Chang remonstrated regarding the Six Monopolies; Wang Mang was greatly angered and removed Chang from office.

sentences.zh: 法令煩苛，民搖手觸禁，不得耕桑，繇役煩劇，而枯旱、蝗蟲相因，獄訟不決。

translations.literal: Laws and orders were numerous and harsh; the people, waving their hands, touched prohibitions and could not plow or tend silkworms; corvée labor was vexing and heavy, while drought and locusts followed one upon another, and prison cases were not decided.
translations.idiomatic: Laws and orders were numerous and harsh; the people, waving their hands, touched prohibitions and could not plow or tend silkworms; corvée labor was vexing and heavy, while drought and locusts followed one upon another, and prison cases were not decided.

sentences.zh: 吏用苛暴立威，旁緣莽禁，侵刻小民，富者不自保，貧者無以自存，於是並起為盜賊，依阻山澤，吏不能禽而覆蔽之，浸淫日廣。

translations.literal: Officials used harsh violence to establish authority, clinging to Mang's prohibitions to encroach upon and carve the lesser people; the rich could not preserve themselves, the poor had no means to preserve themselves—thereupon they together rose as bandits, relying on mountains and marshes; officials could not capture them and instead covered for them, and the plague spread daily wider.
translations.idiomatic: Officials used harsh violence to establish authority, clinging to Wang Mang's prohibitions to encroach upon and carve the lesser people; the rich could not preserve themselves, the poor had no means to preserve themselves—thereupon they together rose as bandits, relying on mountains and marshes; officials could not capture them and instead covered for them, and the plague spread daily wider.

sentences.zh: 臨淮瓜田儀等依阻會稽長州；

translations.literal: Guatian Yi of Linhuai and others relied on Changzhou in Kuaiji;
translations.idiomatic: Guatian Yi of Linhuai and others relied on Changzhou in Kuaiji;

sentences.zh: 琅邪呂母聚黨數千人，殺海曲宰，入海中為盜，其眾浸多，至萬數。

translations.literal: the mother of the Lü clan of Langye gathered a faction of several thousand men, killed the magistrate of Haiqu, entered the sea to become bandits—her host gradually grew to ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: the mother of the Lü clan of Langye gathered a faction of several thousand men, killed the magistrate of Haiqu, entered the sea to become bandits—her host gradually grew to ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 荊州饑饉，民眾入野澤，掘鳧茈而食之，更相侵奪。

translations.literal: Jing province suffered famine; the masses entered wilds and marshes, dug arrowhead tubers and ate them, and seized from one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jing province suffered famine; the masses entered wilds and marshes, dug arrowhead tubers and ate them, and seized from one another.

sentences.zh: 新市人王匡、王鳳為平理諍訟，遂推為渠帥，眾數百人。

translations.literal: Wang Kuang and Wang Feng of Xinshi settled disputes and quarrels and were thereupon pushed forward as chieftains—the host numbered several hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kuang and Wang Feng of Xinshi settled disputes and quarrels and were thereupon pushed forward as chieftains—the host numbered several hundred.

sentences.zh: 於是諸亡命者南陽馬武、穎川王常、成丹等，皆往從之。

translations.literal: Thereupon all the fugitives—Ma Wu of Nanyang, Wang Chang of Yingchuan, Cheng Dan, and others—all went to follow them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all the fugitives—Ma Wu of Nanyang, Wang Chang of Yingchuan, Cheng Dan, and others—all went to follow them.

sentences.zh: 共攻離鄉聚，臧於綠林山中，數月間至七八千人。

translations.literal: Together they attacked Lixiang hamlet, hid in the Green Forest mountains, and within several months reached seven or eight thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Together they attacked Lixiang hamlet, hid in the Green Forest mountains, and within several months reached seven or eight thousand.

sentences.zh: 又有南郡張霸、江夏羊牧等與王匡俱起，眾皆萬人。

translations.literal: Again there were Zhang Ba of Nan commandery, Yang Mu of Jiangxia, and others who rose together with Wang Kuang—each host ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Again there were Zhang Ba of Nan commandery, Yang Mu of Jiangxia, and others who rose together with Wang Kuang—each host ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 莽遣使者即赦盜賊，還言：「盜賊解輒復合，問其故，皆曰：『愁法禁煩苛，不得舉手，力作所得，不足以給貢稅；

translations.literal: Mang sent envoys at once to amnesty the bandits; on returning they said: "The bandits disband and then reunite; when asked the reason, all said: 'We grieve that laws and prohibitions are vexing and harsh—we cannot lift a hand; what labor produces is not enough to supply tribute and tax;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent envoys at once to amnesty the bandits; on returning they said, "The bandits disband and then reunite; when asked the reason, all said, 'We grieve that laws and prohibitions are vexing and harsh—we cannot lift a hand; what labor produces is not enough to supply tribute and tax;

sentences.zh: 閉門自守，又坐鄰伍鑄錢挾銅，奸吏因以愁民。

translations.literal: shut the door and keep to ourselves, yet again are implicated by the neighborhood watch for casting cash and carrying copper—treacherous officials thereby grieve the people.
translations.idiomatic: shut the door and keep to ourselves, yet again are implicated by the neighborhood watch for casting cash and carrying copper—treacherous officials thereby grieve the people.

sentences.zh: 』民窮，悉起為盜賊。

translations.literal: ' The people are destitute—all rise as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: ' The people are destitute—all rise as bandits.

sentences.zh: 」莽大怒，免之。

translations.literal: " Mang was greatly enraged and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was furious and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 其或順指言「民驕黠當誅」及言「時運適然，且滅不久」，莽說，輒遷官。

translations.literal: Some who followed his meaning said 'the people are arrogant and cunning and ought to be executed,' or said 'the times are simply so, and he will soon perish'—Mang was pleased and at once promoted them.
translations.idiomatic: Some who read his mood said the people were arrogant and cunning and ought to be executed, or that the times were simply against him and he would soon fall—Wang Mang was pleased and promptly promoted them.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，朔，北軍南門災。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the new moon, fire at the Northern Army's southern gate.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, on the first day of the first month, fire struck the southern gate of the Northern Army.

sentences.zh: 以大司馬司允費興為荊州牧；

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Director of Fidelity Fei Xing was made Governor of Jingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Fei Xing, Director of Fidelity under the Grand Marshal, was appointed Governor of Jingzhou;

sentences.zh: 見，問到部方略，興對曰：「荊、揚之民，率依阻山澤，以漁采為業。

translations.literal: On audience, asked his strategy on reaching his post; Xing replied: "The people of Jing and Yang mostly rely on mountains and marshes for refuge, taking fishing and gathering as their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: When he was received in audience and asked his plan for taking up the post, Xing replied: "The people of Jing and Yang mostly shelter in mountains and marshes and live by fishing and gathering.

sentences.zh: 間者國張六筦，稅山澤，妨奪民之利，連年久旱，百姓饑窮，故為盜賊。

translations.literal: Recently the state spread the six monopolies and taxed mountains and marshes, harming and seizing the people's profit; years of long drought—the common people hungry and destitute—hence they became bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the state imposed the six monopolies and taxed mountains and marshes, robbing the people's livelihood; after years of drought the common people were hungry and destitute, and so they turned to banditry.

sentences.zh: 興到部，欲令明曉告盜賊歸田裡，假貸犁牛、種食，闊其租賦，冀可以解釋安集。

translations.literal: When Xing reaches his post, he wishes to make clear and instruct bandits to return to their hamlets, lend plows, oxen, and seed grain, and reduce their rents and levies, hoping thereby to explain, release, and settle them.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching his post I intend to make clear to the bandits that they should return to their villages, lend them plows, oxen, and seed grain, and reduce their rents and levies, hoping thereby to pacify and settle them.

sentences.zh: 」莽怒，免興官。

translations.literal: " Mang was enraged and dismissed Xing from office.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was enraged and dismissed Xing from office.

sentences.zh: 天下吏以不得俸祿，並為奸利，郡尹、縣宰家累千金。

translations.literal: Officers throughout the realm, receiving no salaries, all practiced corruption for profit; commandery heads and county magistrates' families amassed thousands in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Because officials throughout the realm received no salaries, all turned to corrupt profit; commandery heads and county magistrates' families piled up thousands in gold.

sentences.zh: 莽乃考始建國二年胡虜猾夏以來諸軍吏及緣邊吏大夫以上為奸利增產致富者，收其家所有財產五分之四以助邊急。

translations.literal: Mang then investigated since Beginning Establishment year 2, when the northern barbarians troubled Xia, all army officers and frontier officers of grandee rank and above who grew rich by corrupt profit and increasing holdings, and took four-fifths of all their household property to aid the border emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang then investigated all army officers and frontier officials of grandee rank and above who had grown rich by corruption since the northern barbarians troubled the realm in Beginning Establishment year 2, and confiscated four-fifths of their household property to aid the border emergency.

sentences.zh: 公府士馳傳天下，考覆貪饕，關吏告其將、奴婢告其主，冀以禁奸，而奸愈甚。

translations.literal: Government clerks galloped post-horses through the realm investigating and reviewing greed; gate officers reported their commanders, slaves and maids reported their masters—hoping to forbid corruption, yet corruption grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Government runners sped post-horses through the realm to investigate greed; gate officers denounced their superiors and slaves denounced their masters—hoping to stop corruption, yet it only grew worse.

sentences.zh: 莽孫功崇公宗坐自畫容貌，被服天子衣冠，刻三印，發覺，自殺。

translations.literal: Mang's grandson Duke of Merit and Veneration Zong, charged with painting his own likeness, wearing the Son of Heaven's robes and cap, and carving three seals—when discovered, he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang's grandson, Duke of Merit and Veneration Zong, was discovered to have painted his own portrait, worn the Son of Heaven's robes and cap, and carved three seals; he killed himself.

sentences.zh: 宗姊妨為衛將軍王興夫人，坐祝詛姑，殺婢以絕口，與興皆自殺。

translations.literal: Zong's elder sister Fang was wife of Guard General Wang Xing; charged with cursing her mother-in-law and killing a maid to stop her mouth—she and Xing both killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Zong's elder sister Fang was wife of Guard General Wang Xing; charged with cursing her mother-in-law and killing a maid to silence her, she and Xing both killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 是歲，揚雄卒。

translations.literal: That year Yang Xiong died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Xiong died.

sentences.zh: 初，成帝之世，雄為郎，給事黃門，與莽及劉秀並列；

translations.literal: Earlier, in Emperor Cheng's reign, Xiong was a gentleman, serving at the Yellow Gate, ranked together with Mang and Liu Xin;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Emperor Cheng's reign, Xiong served as a gentleman at the Yellow Gate, alongside Wang Mang and Liu Xin;

sentences.zh: 哀帝之初，又與董賢同官。

translations.literal: at the beginning of Emperor Ai's reign he again held office together with Dong Xian.
translations.idiomatic: at the beginning of Emperor Ai's reign he again held office together with Dong Xian.

sentences.zh: 莽、賢為三公，權傾人主，所薦莫不拔擢，而雄三世不徙官。

translations.literal: Mang and Xian became the Three Dukes, their power overwhelming the ruler; everyone they recommended was promoted, yet Xiong through three reigns was not moved in office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang and Dong Xian became the Three Dukes and their power overwhelmed the throne; everyone they recommended was promoted, yet Xiong was not moved in office through three reigns.

sentences.zh: 及莽篡位，雄以耆老久次，轉為大夫。

translations.literal: When Mang usurped the throne, Xiong by seniority and long tenure was transferred to grandee.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Mang usurped the throne, Xiong by seniority and long service was made a grandee.

sentences.zh: 恬於勢利，好古樂道，欲以文章成名於後世，乃作《大玄》以綜天、地、人之道；

translations.literal: Tranquil toward power and profit, loving antiquity and delighting in the Way, wishing to make a name in later ages through literature, he then composed the Supreme Mystery to synthesize the ways of Heaven, Earth, and Man;
translations.idiomatic: Indifferent to power and profit, devoted to antiquity and the Way, and wishing to win lasting fame through literature, he composed the Supreme Mystery to synthesize the ways of Heaven, Earth, and Man;

sentences.zh: 又見諸子各以其智舛馳，大抵詆訾聖人，即為怪迂、析辯詭辭以撓世事，雖小辯，終破大道而惑眾，使溺於所聞而不自知其非也，故人時有問雄者，常用法應之，號曰《法言》。

translations.literal: He also saw the various masters each with his own intelligence running astray, mostly slandering the sages and then making strange perversity and analytic sophistry to thwart worldly affairs—though small in debate, in the end breaking the great Way and confusing the multitude, making them drown in what they heard without knowing their error; therefore when people occasionally questioned Xiong, he regularly answered by the method and titled it Exemplary Words.
translations.idiomatic: He also saw the various masters each racing off with his own cleverness, mostly slandering the sages and producing eccentric sophistry to thwart public affairs—small disputations that in the end shattered the great Way and misled the people, drowning them in what they had heard without knowing their error; when people questioned him, he answered by method and called the work Exemplary Words.

sentences.zh: 用心於內，不求於外，於時人皆忽之；

translations.literal: He applied his mind within and did not seek without; people of the time all neglected him;
translations.idiomatic: He turned his mind inward and sought nothing from the world; people of the time all neglected him;

sentences.zh: 唯劉秀及范逡敬焉，而桓譚以為絕倫，巨鹿侯芭師事焉。

translations.literal: only Liu Xin and Fan Xun honored him, while Huan Tan considered him without peer, and Marquis Ba of Julu took him as master.
translations.idiomatic: only Liu Xin and Fan Xun honored him; Huan Tan considered him without peer; and Marquis Ba of Julu became his student.

sentences.zh: 大司空王邑、納言嚴尤聞雄死，謂桓譚曰：「子常稱揚雄書，豈能傳於後世乎？

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi and Director of Speech Yan You, hearing Xiong had died, said to Huan Tan: "You often praise Yang Xiong's writings—can they be handed down to later ages?
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi and Director of Speech Yan You, hearing that Xiong had died, said to Huan Tan: "You often praise Yang Xiong's writings—can they be handed down to later ages?

sentences.zh: 」譚曰：「必傳，顧君與譚不及見也。

translations.literal: " Tan said: "They will certainly be handed down—only that my lord and Tan will not live to see it.
translations.idiomatic: " Tan said: "They certainly will be handed down—only that you and I will not live to see it.

sentences.zh: 凡人賤近而貴遠，親見揚子雲祿位容貌不能動人，故輕其書。

translations.literal: Ordinary people despise what is near and honor what is distant; having personally seen Master Yang Yun's salary, rank, and appearance unable to move people, they therefore slight his books.
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary people despise what is near and honor what is distant; having seen Yang Yun's modest salary, rank, and appearance fail to impress them, they slight his books.

sentences.zh: 昔老聃著虛無之言兩篇，薄仁義，非禮學，然後好之者尚以為過於《五經》，自漢文、景之君及司馬遷皆有是言。

translations.literal: Formerly Laozi wrote two chapters of empty-nonbeing discourse, slighting benevolence and righteousness and rejecting ritual learning—yet those who favored him still held them superior to the Five Classics; from the rulers Wen and Jing of Han down to Sima Qian there have been such words.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Laozi wrote two chapters of empty-nonbeing discourse, slighting benevolence and righteousness and rejecting ritual learning—yet admirers still held them superior to the Five Classics; from Emperors Wen and Jing of Han down to Sima Qian, many have said so.

sentences.zh: 今揚子之書文義至深，而論不詭於聖人，則必度越諸子矣！

translations.literal: Now Master Yang's books in literary meaning are extremely deep, and in doctrine not perverse against the sages—then they will certainly surpass the various masters!
translations.idiomatic: Now Master Yang's books are profound in meaning and in doctrine not perverse against the sages—they will certainly surpass the various masters!

sentences.zh: 琅邪樊崇起兵於莒，眾百餘人，轉入太山。

translations.literal: Langye Fan Chong raised troops at Ju, his host a hundred-odd men, and shifted into Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chong of Langye raised troops at Ju with a band of a little over a hundred men, then moved into Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 群盜以崇勇猛，皆附之，一歲間至萬餘人。

translations.literal: Bandits everywhere, because Chong was fierce and brave, all attached to him; within a year he reached more than ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits everywhere, seeing Chong's fierceness and courage, all joined him; within a year his force reached more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 崇同郡人逄安、東海人徐宣、謝祿、楊音各起兵，合數萬人，復引從崇。

translations.literal: Chong's fellow commandery man Pang An, and men of Donghai Xu Xuan, Xie Lu, and Yang Yin each raised troops; together several tens of thousands, they again led their followers to Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Pang An of Chong's commandery, and Xu Xuan, Xie Lu, and Yang Yin of Donghai each raised troops; together they mustered tens of thousands and again brought their followers to Chong.

sentences.zh: 共還攻莒，不能下，轉掠青、徐間。

translations.literal: Together they returned to attack Ju but could not take it, and turned to plunder between Qing and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Together they returned to attack Ju but could not take it, and turned to plunder the Qing and Xu region.

sentences.zh: 又有東海刁子都，亦起兵鈔擊徐、兗。

translations.literal: There was also Diao Zidu of Donghai, who also raised troops to raid and strike Xu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Diao Zidu of Donghai also raised troops to raid Xu and Yan.

sentences.zh: 莽遣使者發郡國兵擊之，不能克。

translations.literal: Mang sent envoys to mobilize commandery and state troops to attack them but could not overcome them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent envoys to mobilize commandery and state troops against them but could not defeat them.

sentences.zh: 烏累單于死，弟左賢王輿立，為呼都而屍道皋若鞮單于。

translations.literal: Chanyu Wulei died; his younger brother the Left Wise King Yu succeeded, becoming Chanyu Huduershidao Gaoroudi.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyu Wulei died; his younger brother the Left Wise King Yu succeeded as Chanyu Huduershidao Gaoroudi.

sentences.zh: 輿既立，貪利賞賜，遣大且渠奢與伊墨居次雲女弟之子醯櫝王，俱奉獻至長安。

translations.literal: Yu having succeeded, greedy for rewards and gifts, sent the Great Commander She and Xiyu King, son of Yimojuci Yun's younger sister's daughter, together to present tribute at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yu had succeeded, greedy for rewards and gifts, he sent the Great Commander She and Xiyu King, a grandson of Yimojuci Yun, together to present tribute at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 莽遣和親侯歙與奢等俱至制虜塞下，與雲及須卜當會；

translations.literal: Mang sent Marquis of Peace and Kinship She together with She and the others to below the Restrain-Barbarians pass, to meet with Yun and Xubu Dang;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent Marquis of Peace and Kinship She together with She and the others to below the Restrain-Barbarians pass to meet Yun and Xubu Dang;

sentences.zh: 因以兵迫脅雲、當，將至長安。

translations.literal: and thereby with troops coerced Yun and Dang, intending to bring them to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: and there used troops to coerce Yun and Dang, intending to bring them to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 雲、當小男從塞下得脫，歸匈奴。

translations.literal: Yun and Dang's young son escaped from below the pass and returned to the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Yun and Dang's young son escaped below the pass and returned to the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 當至長安，莽拜為須卜單于，欲出大兵以輔立之，兵調度亦不合。

translations.literal: Dang reached Chang'an; Mang enfeoffed him as Chanyu Xubu, wishing to send a great army to install and support him, but troop mobilization also did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Dang reached Chang'an; Wang Mang invested him as Chanyu Xubu and wished to send a great army to install him, but troop mobilization also failed to come together.

sentences.zh: 而匈奴愈怒，並入北邊為寇。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Xiongnu grew angrier and together entered the northern border as raiders.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Xiongnu grew angrier and together raided the northern border.

sentences.zh: 春，莽見盜賊多，乃令太史推三萬六千歲曆紀，六歲一改元，布天下。

translations.literal: In spring, Mang seeing bandits many, then ordered the Grand Astrologer to calculate a calendar of thirty-six thousand years, changing the era name every six years, and promulgated it through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, seeing bandits growing numerous, Wang Mang ordered the Grand Astrologer to calculate a calendar of thirty-six thousand years with a new era name every six years, and promulgated it through the realm.

sentences.zh: 下書自言己當如黃帝仙升天，欲以誑耀百姓，銷解盜賊。

translations.literal: He issued a document saying himself ought like the Yellow Emperor to ascend as immortal—wishing thereby to deceive and dazzle the common people and dissolve the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He issued a document saying he would ascend as an immortal like the Yellow Emperor, hoping thereby to dazzle the people and dissolve the bandits.

sentences.zh: 眾皆笑之。

translations.literal: The multitude all laughed at him.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone laughed at him.

sentences.zh: 初獻《新樂》於明堂、太廟。

translations.literal: For the first time the New Music was presented at the Bright Hall and Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The New Music was presented for the first time at the Bright Hall and Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 更始將軍廉丹擊益州，不能克。

translations.literal: General of Renewal Lian Dan attacked Yizhou but could not overcome it.
translations.idiomatic: General of Renewal Lian Dan attacked Yizhou but could not overcome it.

sentences.zh: 益州夷棟蠶、若豆等起兵殺郡守，越巂夷人大牟亦叛，殺略吏人。

translations.literal: Yi of Yizhou Dongcan, Ruodou, and others raised troops and killed the commandery administrator; the Yi chieftain Damou of Yuexi also rebelled, killing and plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi Dongcan, Ruodou, and others of Yizhou raised troops and killed the commandery administrator; the Yi chieftain Damou of Yuexi also rebelled, killing and plundering officials and people.

sentences.zh: 莽召丹還，更遣大司馬護軍郭興、庸部牧李曄擊蠻夷若豆等、太傅羲叔士孫喜清潔江湖之盜賊。

translations.literal: Mang recalled Dan and again sent Grand Marshal Protector of the Army Guo Xing and Governor of Yong Li Ye to attack the barbarians Ruodou and others, and Grand Tutor Xishu Scholar Sun Xi to clear the rivers and lakes of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang recalled Dan and instead sent Grand Marshal Protector of the Army Guo Xing and Governor of Yong Li Ye against the barbarians Ruodou and others, and Grand Tutor Xishu Scholar Sun Xi to clear bandits from the rivers and lakes.

sentences.zh: 而匈奴寇邊甚，莽乃大募天下丁男及死罪囚、吏民奴，名曰豬突、豨勇，以為銳卒。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the Xiongnu raided the border severely; Mang then greatly recruited adult males throughout the realm, death-sentence convicts, and officials', commoners', and slaves—named Hog Rush and Boar Boldness—as crack troops.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the Xiongnu raided the border severely; Wang Mang then recruited adult males throughout the realm, death-sentence convicts, and officials', commoners', and slaves—called Hog Rush and Boar Boldness—as crack troops.

sentences.zh: 一切稅天下吏民，訾三十取一，縑帛皆輸長安。

translations.literal: He taxed all officials and commoners under heaven at one rate, one part in thirty of assessed wealth, and all silk and cloth were sent to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He levied a universal tax on officials and commoners, one part in thirty of assessed wealth, and all silk and cloth were sent to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 令公卿以下至郡縣黃綬皆保養軍馬，多少各以秩為差，吏盡復以與民。

translations.literal: He ordered all from the upper dukes down to commandery and county holders of the yellow seal-cord to maintain army horses, more or less each according to rank as the difference, and officials were all again to pass the burden to the people.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered everyone from the upper dukes down to commandery and county holders of the yellow seal-cord to maintain army horses in amounts fixed by rank, and officials again passed the burden to the people.

sentences.zh: 又博募有奇技術可以攻匈奴者，將待以不次之位，言便宜者以萬數。

translations.literal: He also broadly recruited those with strange skills and arts who could attack the Xiongnu, intending to treat them with extraordinary rank; those speaking of expedients numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: He also broadly recruited men with strange skills who could attack the Xiongnu, promising extraordinary rank; those offering expedients numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 或言能度水不用舟楫，連馬接騎，濟百萬師。

translations.literal: Some said they could cross water without boats or oars, linking horses and connecting riders to ferry a million troops.
translations.idiomatic: Some said they could cross water without boats or oars, linking horses and riders to ferry a million troops.

sentences.zh: 或言不持斗糧，服食藥物，三軍不饑。

translations.literal: Some said without carrying a peck of grain, by ingesting drugs the three armies would not hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Some said that without carrying a peck of grain, by taking drugs the three armies would not hunger.

sentences.zh: 或言能飛，一日千里，可窺匈奴；

translations.literal: Some said they could fly a thousand li in a day and spy on the Xiongnu;
translations.idiomatic: Some said they could fly a thousand li in a day and spy on the Xiongnu;

sentences.zh: 莽輒試之，取大鳥翮為兩翼，頭與身皆著毛，通引環紐，飛數百步墮。

translations.literal: Mang at once tested them, taking great birds' pinions as two wings, head and body all covered with feathers, drawing through ring clasps—they flew several hundred paces and fell.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang promptly tested them: great birds' pinions were made into two wings, head and body were covered with feathers, and ring clasps were drawn through—they flew several hundred paces and fell.

sentences.zh: 莽知其不可用，苟欲獲其名，皆拜為理軍，賜以車馬，待發。

translations.literal: Mang knew they were unusable but wished merely to obtain their names; all were appointed as army regulators, given chariots and horses, and held awaiting dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang knew they were useless but wished merely to win their names; all were appointed army regulators, given chariots and horses, and held awaiting dispatch.

sentences.zh: 初，莽之欲誘迎須卜當也，大司馬嚴尤諫曰：「當在匈奴右部，兵不侵邊，單于動靜輒語中國，此方面之大助也。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Mang wished to entice and welcome Xubu Dang, Grand Marshal Yan You remonstrated: "Dang is in the Xiongnu's right wing; his troops do not invade the border, and whenever the chanyu moves or is still he at once tells China—this is a great aid on that frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Wang Mang wished to entice and welcome Xubu Dang, Grand Marshal Yan You remonstrated: "Dang is in the Xiongnu's right wing; his troops do not invade the border, and whenever the chanyu moves he reports it to China—this is a great aid on that frontier.

sentences.zh: 於今迎當置長安槁街，一胡人耳，不如在匈奴有益。

translations.literal: Now to welcome Dang and place him on Chang'an's withered street is only one barbarian—he is not as beneficial in the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: To welcome Dang now and place him on Chang'an's withered street is only one barbarian—he is more useful left among the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 」莽不聽。

translations.literal: " Mang did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang did not listen.

sentences.zh: 既得當，欲遣尤與廉丹擊匈奴，皆賜姓征氏，號二征將軍，令誅單于輿而立當代之。

translations.literal: Having obtained Dang, he wished to send You together with Lian Dan to attack the Xiongnu; both were granted the surname Zheng and titled the Two Zheng Generals, ordered to execute Chanyu Yu and install Dang in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Having obtained Dang, he wished to send You with Lian Dan against the Xiongnu; both were granted the surname Zheng and titled the Two Zheng Generals, ordered to kill Chanyu Yu and install Dang in his place.

sentences.zh: 出車城西橫廄，未發。

translations.literal: They went out to the transverse stables west of the city gate but did not depart.
translations.idiomatic: They went out to the transverse stables west of the city gate but did not depart.

sentences.zh: 尤素有智略，非莽攻伐四夷，數諫不從，及當出，廷議，尤固言：「匈奴可且以為後，先憂山東盜賊。

translations.literal: You had long possessed strategy and was opposed to Mang's attacking the four barbarians; he remonstrated several times without being followed, and when they were to set out, at court deliberation You firmly said: "The Xiongnu may for the moment be left for later; first worry over the bandits east of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: You had long possessed strategy and opposed Wang Mang's campaigns against the four barbarians; he remonstrated several times without success, and when they were to set out, at court deliberation he firmly said: "The Xiongnu may be left for later; first worry over the bandits east of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 」莽大怒，策免尤。

translations.literal: " Mang was greatly enraged and by written order dismissed You.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was furious and dismissed You by written order.

sentences.zh: 大司空議曹史代郡范升奏記王邑曰：「升聞子以人不間於其父母為孝，臣以下不非其君上為忠。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Review Clerk Fan Sheng of Dai commandery submitted a note to Wang Yi saying: "Sheng has heard that the son is filial when he does not come between his parents, and the minister loyal when below he does not speak ill of his ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Review Clerk Fan Sheng of Dai commandery under the Grand Minister of Works submitted a note to Wang Yi saying: "Sheng has heard that a son is filial when he does not come between his parents, and a minister loyal when he does not speak ill of his ruler below.

sentences.zh: 今眾人咸稱朝聖，皆曰公明。

translations.literal: Now the multitude all call the court sage and all say my lord is perspicuous.
translations.idiomatic: Now everyone calls the court sage and says my lord is perspicuous.

sentences.zh: 蓋明者無不見，聖者無不聞。

translations.literal: For the perspicuous there is nothing unseen; for the sage there is nothing unheard.
translations.idiomatic: The perspicuous see everything; the sage hears everything.

sentences.zh: 今天下之事，昭昭於日月，震震於雷霆，而朝雲不見，公雲不聞，則元元焉所呼天！

translations.literal: Yet affairs under heaven today are bright as sun and moon, thunderous as thunderclaps—while the court's clouds do not see and my lord's clouds do not hear; then to what will the common people call upon Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Yet affairs under heaven today are bright as sun and moon and thunderous as thunder—while the court does not see and my lord does not hear; to whom then can the common people cry to Heaven!

sentences.zh: 公以為是而不言，則過小矣；

translations.literal: If my lord holds it right yet does not speak, the fault is small;
translations.idiomatic: If my lord holds this right yet does not speak, the fault is small;

sentences.zh: 知而從令，則過大矣。

translations.literal: if knowing yet following orders, the fault is great.
translations.idiomatic: if knowing yet following orders, the fault is great.

sentences.zh: 二者於公無可以免，宜乎天下歸怨於公矣。

translations.literal: Of these two, my lord cannot escape either; it is fitting that all under heaven should turn resentment upon my lord.
translations.idiomatic: Between these two my lord cannot escape either; it is fitting that all under heaven should turn resentment upon my lord.

sentences.zh: 朝以遠者不服為至念，升以近者不悅為重憂。

translations.literal: The court takes those far off not submitting as its utmost concern; Sheng takes those near not content as his heavy worry.
translations.idiomatic: The court takes distant peoples' refusal to submit as its utmost concern; Sheng takes nearby people's discontent as his heavy worry.

sentences.zh: 今動與時戾，事與道反，馳騖覆車之轍，踵循敗事之後，後出益可怪，晚發愈可懼耳。

translations.literal: Now movement goes against the times and affairs run counter to the Way, galloping in the tracks of overturned carts and treading in the wake of failed undertakings—the later the setting out, the stranger; the later the dispatch, the more fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Now movement goes against the times and affairs run counter to the Way, galloping in overturned carts' tracks and treading failed undertakings' wake—the later the setting out, the stranger; the later the dispatch, the more fearful.

sentences.zh: 方春歲首而動發遠役，藜藿不充，田荒不耕，穀價騰躍，斛至數千，吏民陷於湯火之中，非國家之民也。

translations.literal: Just at spring's year-start to move and dispatch distant service—wild greens not filled, fields waste and uncultivated, grain prices leaping, a hu reaching several thousand; officials and people trapped in boiling water and fire—not the state's people.
translations.idiomatic: Just at spring's year-start to dispatch distant campaigns—wild greens uneaten, fields waste and uncultivated, grain prices soaring to several thousand cash a hu, officials and people trapped in boiling water and fire—they are no longer the state's people.

sentences.zh: 如此，則胡、貊守闕，青、徐之寇在於帷帳矣。

translations.literal: If so, then Hu and Mo guard the gate-towers while the raiders of Qing and Xu are within the curtain and canopy.
translations.idiomatic: If so, the northern barbarians will guard the gate-towers while the raiders of Qing and Xu are already within the curtain.

sentences.zh: 升有一言，可以解天下倒縣，免元元之急；

translations.literal: Sheng has one word that can release all under heaven hanging upside down and free the common people's urgency;
translations.idiomatic: Sheng has one word that can release the realm hanging upside down and relieve the common people's urgency;

sentences.zh: 不可書傳，願蒙引見，極陳所懷。

translations.literal: it cannot be written and transmitted; he wishes to receive an audience and fully state what he harbors.
translations.idiomatic: it cannot be written and transmitted; he asks to be granted an audience to state fully what he harbors.

sentences.zh: 」邑不聽。

translations.literal: " Yi did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Yi did not listen.

sentences.zh: 翼平連率田況奏郡縣訾民不實，莽復三十取一。

translations.literal: Coordinator of Yiping Tian Kuang memorialized that commanderies and counties assessed the people's wealth untruly; Mang again took one in thirty.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinator of Yiping Tian Kuang memorialized that commanderies and counties had falsely assessed the people's wealth; Wang Mang again levied one part in thirty.

sentences.zh: 以況忠言憂國，進爵為伯，賜錢二百萬，眾庶皆詈之。

translations.literal: Because Kuang's loyal words showed concern for the state, he was advanced in rank to earl and given two million cash; the common multitude all cursed him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Kuang's loyal words showed concern for the state, he was advanced to earl and given two million cash; the common people all cursed him.

sentences.zh: 青、徐民多棄鄉里流亡，老弱死道路，壯者入賊中。

translations.literal: The people of Qing and Xu mostly abandoned their villages and hamlets in flight; the old and weak died on the roads, the strong entered the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Qing and Xu mostly abandoned their villages and fled; the old and weak died on the roads, the strong joined the bandits.

sentences.zh: 夙夜連率韓博上言：「有奇士，長丈，大十圍，來至臣府，曰欲奮擊胡虜，自謂巨毋霸，出於蓬萊東南五城西北昭如海瀕，軺車不能載，三馬不能勝。

translations.literal: Coordinator of Suye Han Bo memorialized: "There is a strange man, ten feet tall, ten arm-spans around the waist, who came to my office saying he wished to strike the northern barbarians with might; he calls himself Mega-No-Overlord, coming from southeast of Penglai, northwest of Five Cities, on the shore of Zhaoru Sea—a light carriage cannot carry him, three horses cannot bear him.
translations.idiomatic: Coordinator of Suye Han Bo memorialized: "There is a strange man ten feet tall and ten arm-spans around the waist who came to my office saying he wished to strike the northern barbarians with might; he calls himself Mega-No-Overlord, from southeast of Penglai and northwest of Five Cities on the shore of Zhaoru Sea—a light carriage cannot carry him, three horses cannot bear him.

sentences.zh: 即日以大車四馬，建虎旗，載霸詣闕。

translations.literal: That very day with a great cart and four horses, raising a tiger banner, he carried Overlord to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: That very day with a great cart and four horses and a tiger banner raised, he carried Overlord to the palace.

sentences.zh: 霸臥則枕鼓，以鐵箸食，此皇天所以輔新室也。

translations.literal: Overlord when lying used a drum as pillow and ate with iron chopsticks—this is how August Heaven aids the New House.
translations.idiomatic: Overlord used a drum as his pillow when he lay down and ate with iron chopsticks—this is how August Heaven aids the New House.

sentences.zh: 願陛下作大甲、高車、賁育之衣，遣大將一人與虎賁百人迎之於道。

translations.literal: He wishes Your Majesty to make great armor, a tall carriage, and Ben and Yu's garments, and send one great general with a hundred tiger guards to welcome him on the road.
translations.idiomatic: I ask Your Majesty to make great armor, a tall carriage, and garments fit for Ben and Yu, and send one great general with a hundred tiger guards to welcome him on the road.

sentences.zh: 京師門戶不容者，開高大之，以示百蠻，鎮安天下。

translations.literal: If the capital's gates and doorways will not contain him, open them high and broad to show the hundred barbarians and pacify and settle all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: If the capital's gates will not contain him, open them high and broad to show the hundred barbarians and pacify the realm.

sentences.zh: 」博意欲以風莽，莽聞，惡之，留霸在所新豐，更其姓曰巨母氏，謂因文母太后而霸王符也。

translations.literal: " Bo's intent was to influence Mang by it; Mang heard, hated it, detained Overlord at his place in Xinfeng, changed his surname to Mega-Mother clan, saying thereby through Empress Dowager Wenmu he would obtain the overlord's token.
translations.idiomatic: " Bo intended to influence Wang Mang; Wang Mang heard, hated it, detained Overlord at Xinfeng, changed his surname to the Mega-Mother clan, saying that through Empress Dowager Wenmu he would obtain the token of kingship.

sentences.zh: 徵博，下獄，以非所宜言，棄市。

translations.literal: Bo was summoned, put in prison, and for words not fitting the occasion, executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Bo was summoned, imprisoned, and for speaking what was not fitting, executed in the market.

sentences.zh: 關東饑旱連年，刁子都等黨眾浸多，至六七萬。

translations.literal: East of the passes famine and drought continued year after year; Diao Zidu and his party's host gradually grew to sixty or seventy thousand.
translations.idiomatic: East of the passes famine and drought continued year after year; Diao Zidu and his party gradually grew to sixty or seventy thousand.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，乙未，赦天下。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day yimao, amnesty for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on the day yimao, an amnesty was proclaimed for the realm.

sentences.zh: 改元曰地皇，從三萬六千歲曆號也。

translations.literal: The era name was changed to Earth Sovereign, following the thirty-six-thousand-year calendar's designation.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was changed to Earth Sovereign, following the thirty-six-thousand-year calendar's designation.

sentences.zh: 莽下書曰；

translations.literal: Mang issued a document saying:
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang issued a document saying:

sentences.zh: 「方出軍行師，敢有趨讙犯法者輒論斬，毋須時！

translations.literal: " As troops are about to march, whoever dares rush about shouting and violate the law shall at once be judged and beheaded—no need to wait for the season!
translations.idiomatic: " As troops are about to march, whoever dares rush about shouting and violate the law shall at once be judged and beheaded—no need to wait for the season!

sentences.zh: 」於是春、夏斬人都市，百姓震懼，道路以目。

translations.literal: " Thereupon in spring and summer executions filled the capital market; the common people were shaken with fear, and on the roads they exchanged glances only with their eyes.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon in spring and summer executions filled the capital market; the people were shaken with fear, and on the roads they exchanged glances only with their eyes.

sentences.zh: 莽見四方盜賊多，復欲厭之，又下書曰：「予之皇初祖考黃帝定天下，將兵為上將軍，內設大將，外置大司馬五人，大將軍至士吏凡七十三萬八千九百人，士千三百五十萬人。

translations.literal: Mang seeing bandits many in the four directions, again wished to suppress them, and again issued a document: "My august first ancestor the Yellow Emperor settled all under heaven, led troops as supreme general, set great generals within and placed five grand marshals without—from great general to clerk-soldier altogether seven hundred thirty-eight thousand nine hundred men, soldiers thirteen million five hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing bandits numerous in the four directions, Wang Mang again wished to suppress them and issued another document: "My august first ancestor the Yellow Emperor settled the realm, led troops as supreme general, set great generals within and placed five grand marshals without—from great general to clerk-soldier seven hundred thirty-eight thousand nine hundred men in all, and thirteen million five hundred thousand soldiers.

sentences.zh: 予受符命之文，稽前人，將條備焉。

translations.literal: I have received the writings of talisman-mandate and examined former men—I shall set them forth in order and complete them.
translations.idiomatic: I have received the writings of talisman-mandate and examined former men—I shall set them forth and complete them.

sentences.zh: 」於是置前、後、左、右、中大司馬之位，賜諸州牧至縣宰皆有大將軍、偏、裨、校尉之號焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he established the posts of front, rear, left, right, and center grand marshal, and granted from governors to county magistrates all titles of great general, lieutenant general, assistant general, and colonel.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he established the posts of front, rear, left, right, and center grand marshal, and granted governors down to county magistrates titles of great general, lieutenant general, assistant general, and colonel.

sentences.zh: 乘傳使者經歷郡國，日且十輩，倉無見穀以給；

translations.literal: Post-horse envoys passed through commanderies and states, nearly ten parties a day; granaries had no visible grain to supply them;
translations.idiomatic: Post-horse envoys passed through commanderies and states, nearly ten parties a day; granaries had no visible grain to supply them;

sentences.zh: 傳車馬不能足，賦取道中車馬，取辦於民。

translations.literal: relay chariots and horses could not suffice, and they levied and took road chariots and horses, obtaining completion from the people.
translations.idiomatic: relay chariots and horses could not suffice, and they levied road chariots and horses from the people.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，大風毀王路堂。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, a great wind destroyed the Hall of the King's Way.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, a great wind destroyed the Hall of the King's Way.

sentences.zh: 莽下書曰：「乃壬午食甫時，有烈風雷雨發屋折木之變，予甚恐焉；

translations.literal: Mang issued a document: "At the hour of eating in the fu period on the day renwu, there was the change of fierce wind, thunder rain, houses bursting, and trees breaking—I am greatly afraid;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang issued a document: "At the hour of eating in the fu period on the day renwu there came fierce wind, thunder rain, houses bursting, and trees breaking—I am greatly afraid;

sentences.zh: 伏念一旬，迷乃解矣。

translations.literal: Lie down and consider one ten-day period, and the delusion will then dissolve.
translations.idiomatic: If you reflect on it for ten days, the delusion will then clear.

sentences.zh: 昔符命文立安為新遷王，臨國洛陽，為統義陽王，議者皆曰：『臨國洛陽為統，謂據土中為新室統也，宜為皇太子。

translations.literal: Formerly mandate-omen texts established An as King of New Migration and King Who Unifies Yiyang, and had Lin rule the state at Luoyang; debaters all said: 'Lin ruling the state at Luoyang as Unifier means holding the central earth as the New House's succession—he ought to be crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly mandate-omen texts established An as King of New Migration and King Who Unifies Yiyang and had Lin rule the state at Luoyang; debaters all said, "Lin ruling the state at Luoyang as Unifier means holding the central earth as the New House's succession—he ought to be crown prince."

sentences.zh: 』自此後，臨久病，雖瘳不平。

translations.literal: ' From this onward Lin was long ill; though cured he was not at ease.
translations.idiomatic: " From this time Lin was chronically ill; though he recovered, he was never well.

sentences.zh: 臨有兄而稱太子，名不正。

translations.literal: Lin had an elder brother yet was called crown prince—the title was not correct.
translations.idiomatic: Lin had an elder brother yet was called crown prince—the title was improper.
