sentences.zh: 惟即位以來，陰陽未和，穀稼鮮耗，蠻夷猾夏，寇賊奸宄，人民徵營，無所錯手足。

translations.literal: Since assuming the throne, yin and yang have not harmonized, grain harvests are scarce and depleted, barbarians harass the Xia, bandits and evil-doers [abound], the people are pressed and harried, with nowhere to set hand or foot.
translations.idiomatic: Since assuming the throne, yin and yang have not harmonized, grain harvests have been poor, barbarians harass the heartland, bandits and villains abound, and the people are harried with nowhere to turn.

sentences.zh: 深惟厥咎，在名不正焉。

translations.literal: Deeply considering the fault, it lies in the incorrect title.
translations.idiomatic: On deep reflection, the fault lies in the improper title.

sentences.zh: 其立安為新遷王，臨為統義陽王。

translations.literal: [He ordered] that An be established as King of New Migration and Lin as King Who Unifies Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered that An be established as King of New Migration and Lin as King Who Unifies Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 莽又下書曰：「寶黃廝赤。

translations.literal: Mang again issued a document, saying: "Treasure is yellow and minions are red.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang again issued a document, saying, "Treasure is yellow and minions are red."

sentences.zh: 其令郎從官皆衣絳。

translations.literal: Let all attendant officials wear crimson."
translations.idiomatic: Let all attendant officials wear crimson."

sentences.zh: 望氣為數者多言有土功象；

translations.literal: Those who read qi and calculate fate mostly said there was an omen of earth-works;
translations.idiomatic: Qi-readers and fate-calculators mostly said there was an omen of earth-works;

sentences.zh: 九月，甲申，莽起九廟於長安城南，黃帝廟方四十丈，高十七丈，餘廟半之，制度甚盛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiashen, Mang raised nine temples south of Chang'an; the Yellow Emperor's temple was forty zhang square and seventeen zhang high, the rest half that—the regulations were very grand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, Wang Mang built nine temples south of Chang'an; the Yellow Emperor's temple was forty zhang square and seventeen zhang high, the rest half that size—the scale was magnificent.

sentences.zh: 博徵天下工匠及吏民以義入錢穀助作者，駱驛道路；

translations.literal: He broadly summoned craftsmen from all under Heaven and officials and people who contributed money and grain for righteousness to aid the work—the roads were continuous with couriers;
translations.idiomatic: He broadly summoned craftsmen from across the realm and officials and commoners who contributed money and grain in the name of righteousness to aid the work, and couriers crowded the roads;

sentences.zh: 窮極百工之巧；

translations.literal: exhausting the ingenuity of all crafts;
translations.idiomatic: exhausting every craft's ingenuity;

sentences.zh: 功費數百餘萬，卒徒死者萬數。

translations.literal: the labor cost several million, and conscript laborers who died numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: the project cost several million, and conscript laborers who died numbered in the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 是月，大雨，六十餘日。

translations.literal: That month, great rain for more than sixty days.
translations.idiomatic: That month there was heavy rain for more than sixty days.

sentences.zh: 巨鹿男子馬適求等謀舉燕、趙兵以誅莽。

translations.literal: A man of Julu, Ma Shiqiu and others, plotted to raise Yan and Zhao troops to execute Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Shiqiu of Julu and others plotted to raise Yan and Zhao troops to kill Wang Mang.

sentences.zh: 大司空士王丹發覺，以聞。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works clerk Wang Dan discovered it and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Wang Dan of the Grand Minister of Works discovered the plot and reported it.

sentences.zh: 莽遣三公大夫逮治黨與，連及郡國豪傑數千人，皆誅死。

translations.literal: Mang sent the Three Ducal Ministers and grandees to arrest and try accomplices, implicating several thousand powerful men of commanderies and states—all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent the Three Ducal Ministers and grandees to arrest and try accomplices, implicating several thousand powerful men across the commanderies and kingdoms—all were executed.

sentences.zh: 封丹為輔國侯。

translations.literal: Dan was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan was enfeoffed as Marquis Who Assists the State.

sentences.zh: 莽以私鑄錢死及非沮寶貨投四裔，犯法者多，不可勝行；

translations.literal: Mang [had decreed that] private casting of cash [merited] death and opposing the treasure goods [meant] casting out to the four borderlands; lawbreakers were many, beyond enforcement;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang had decreed death for private coining and exile to the four borderlands for opposing the new currency; offenders were too many to punish;

sentences.zh: 乃更輕其法，私鑄作泉布者與妻子沒入為官奴婢，吏及比伍知而不舉告，與同罪；

translations.literal: he then lightened the law: those who privately cast cash or made coin-cloth, with wives and children, were confiscated and made official slave girls; officials and mutual-responsibility groups who knew and did not report shared the crime;
translations.idiomatic: he then lightened the law: private coiners and makers of token cloth, with wives and children, were confiscated as government slaves; officials and mutual-responsibility neighbors who knew and failed to report shared the crime;

sentences.zh: 非沮寶貨，民罰作一歲，吏免官。

translations.literal: opposing the treasure goods: commoners were punished with one year of labor, officials were removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: for opposing the treasure goods, commoners were sentenced to one year of labor and officials were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太傅平晏死，以予虞唐尊為太傅。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Ping Yan died; Yu Yu's Tang Zun was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Ping Yan died, and Tang Zun of Yu Yu was appointed Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 尊曰：「國虛民貧，咎在奢泰。

translations.literal: Zun said: "The state is empty and the people poor—the fault lies in extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: Zun said, "The state is empty and the people poor—the fault lies in extravagance."

sentences.zh: 」乃身短衣小褒，乘牝馬、柴車、藉稿，以瓦器飲食，又以歷遺公卿。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he personally wore short clothes and a small robe, rode a mare, a firewood cart, and straw matting, ate and drank from earthenware, and also sent calendars as gifts to the dukes and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he personally wore short clothes and a small robe, rode a mare in a firewood cart on straw matting, ate and drank from earthenware vessels, and sent calendars as gifts to the dukes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 出，見男女不異路者，尊自下車，以象刑赭幡污染其衣。

translations.literal: Going out, when he saw men and women not walking separate roads, Zun himself descended from the carriage and with the symbolic-punishment cinnabar banner stained their clothing.
translations.idiomatic: When he went out and saw men and women not keeping to separate paths, Zun himself descended from his carriage and stained their clothing with the symbolic-punishment cinnabar banner.

sentences.zh: 莽聞而說之，下詔申敕公卿：「思與厥齊。

translations.literal: Mang heard and was pleased; he issued an edict admonishing the dukes and ministers: "Consider making yourselves equal to him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang heard and was pleased; he issued an edict admonishing the dukes and ministers, "Strive to match him."

sentences.zh: 」封尊為平化侯。

translations.literal: " Zun was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pacification and Transformation.
translations.idiomatic: " Zun was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pacification and Transformation.

sentences.zh: 汝南郅惲明天文歷數，以為漢必再受命，上書說莽曰：「上天垂戒，欲悟陛下，令就臣位。

translations.literal: Runan's Zhi Yun understood astronomy and calendrics, believed Han must receive the mandate again, and memorialized to persuade Mang: "Heaven sends warning, wishing to awaken Your Majesty to resume the minister's position.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi Yun of Runan, skilled in astronomy and calendrics, believed the Han must receive the mandate again and memorialized to persuade Wang Mang, "Heaven sends warning, wishing to awaken Your Majesty to resume the minister's position."

sentences.zh: 取之以天，還之以天，可謂知命矣！

translations.literal: Taking it from Heaven, returning it to Heaven—this may be called knowing fate!"
translations.idiomatic: Taking it from Heaven, returning it to Heaven—this may be called knowing fate!"

sentences.zh: 」莽大怒，繫惲詔獄，逾冬，會赦得出。

translations.literal: " Mang was greatly angered, imprisoned Yun in the imperial prison; after winter passed, he was released when an amnesty came.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was greatly angered and imprisoned Zhi Yun in the imperial prison; after winter passed, he was released in a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，莽妻死，謚曰孝睦皇后。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, Mang's wife died; her posthumous title was Empress Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, Wang Mang's wife died and was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaomu.

sentences.zh: 初，莽妻以莽數殺其子，涕泣失明；

translations.literal: Initially Mang's wife, because Mang repeatedly killed their sons, wept until she went blind;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Mang's wife, because he repeatedly killed their sons, wept until she went blind;

sentences.zh: 莽令太子臨居中養焉。

translations.literal: Mang ordered the crown prince Lin to dwell in the central palace and care for her.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang ordered Crown Prince Lin to dwell in the central palace and care for her.

sentences.zh: 莽妻旁侍者原碧，莽幸之，臨亦通焉，恐事洩，謀共殺莽。

translations.literal: Mang's wife's attendant attendant Yuan Bi—Mang favored her, and Lin also had relations with her; fearing exposure, they plotted together to kill Mang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Bi, an attendant beside Wang Mang's wife, was favored by Wang Mang, and Lin also had relations with her; fearing exposure, they plotted together to kill him.

sentences.zh: 臨妻愔，國師公女，能為星，語臨宮中且有白衣會。

translations.literal: Lin's wife Yin, the Director of the State's daughter, could practice star-divination and told Lin there would soon be a gathering in white within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Lin's wife Yin, daughter of the Director of the State, practiced star-divination and told Lin there would soon be a gathering in white within the palace.

sentences.zh: 臨喜，以為所謀且成；

translations.literal: Lin rejoiced, thinking the plot would soon succeed;
translations.idiomatic: Lin rejoiced, thinking their plot would soon succeed;

sentences.zh: 後貶為統義陽王，出在外第，愈憂恐。

translations.literal: later demoted to King Who Unifies Yiyang, living in an outer residence, he grew ever more anxious and afraid.
translations.idiomatic: later demoted to King Who Unifies Yiyang and lodged in an outer residence, he grew ever more anxious and afraid.

sentences.zh: 會莽妻病困，臨予書曰：「上於子孫至嚴，前長孫、中孫年俱三十而死。

translations.literal: When Mang's wife was gravely ill, Lin sent a letter saying: "Your Majesty is extremely strict with sons and grandsons; formerly the eldest grandson and middle grandson both died at exactly thirty.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Mang's wife was gravely ill, Lin sent a letter saying, "Your Majesty is extremely strict with sons and grandsons; formerly the eldest and middle grandsons both died at exactly thirty."

sentences.zh: 今臣臨復適三十，誠恐一旦不保中室，則不知死命所在！

translations.literal: Now your subject Lin again has just reached thirty—I truly fear that if I cannot keep the central chamber safe for a day, I will not know where death and life lie!"
translations.idiomatic: Now your subject Lin has again just reached thirty—I truly fear that if I cannot keep the central palace safe for a day, I will not know where death awaits!"

sentences.zh: 」莽候妻疾，見其書，大怒，疑臨有惡意，不令得會喪。

translations.literal: " Mang attended his wife's illness, saw the letter, was greatly angered, suspected Lin had evil intent, and did not allow him to attend the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was attending his wife's illness, saw the letter, was greatly angered, suspected Lin of evil intent, and did not allow him to attend the mourning.

sentences.zh: 既葬，收原碧等考問，具服奸、謀殺狀。

translations.literal: After the burial, he seized Yuan Bi and others for examination; they fully confessed adultery and the plot to kill.
translations.idiomatic: After the burial, he seized Yuan Bi and the others for interrogation; they fully confessed adultery and the plot to kill him.

sentences.zh: 莽欲秘之，使殺案事使者司命從事，埋獄中，家不知所在。

translations.literal: Mang wished to keep it secret; he had the investigating envoy, Director of Fate attendant, killed and buried in the prison—the family did not know where [the body] was.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang wished to keep it secret; he had the investigating envoy, an attendant of the Director of Fate, killed and buried in the prison, and the family did not know where he was.

sentences.zh: 賜臨藥，臨不肯飲，自刺死。

translations.literal: He gave Lin poison; Lin refused to drink and stabbed himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: He gave Lin poison; Lin refused to drink it and stabbed himself to death.

sentences.zh: 又詔國師公：「臨本不知星，事從愔起。

translations.literal: He also issued an edict to the Director of the State: "Lin originally did not understand stars—the affair arose from Yin.
translations.idiomatic: He also issued an edict to the Director of the State, "Lin originally did not understand stars—the affair arose from Yin."

sentences.zh: 」愔亦自殺。

translations.literal: " Yin also killed herself.
translations.idiomatic: " Yin also killed herself.

sentences.zh: 是月，新遷王安病死。

translations.literal: That month, King of New Migration An died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: That month King of New Migration An died of illness.

sentences.zh: 初，莽為侯就國時，幸侍者增秩、懷能，生子興、匡，皆留新都國，以其不明故也。

translations.literal: Initially when Mang as marquis went to his state, he favored attendants Zeng Zhi and Huai Neng, who bore sons Xing and Kuang—all were left in Xindu state because they were not bright.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Wang Mang as marquis went to his fief, he favored attendants Zeng Zhi and Huai Neng, who bore sons Xing and Kuang; both were left in Xindu because they were deemed dull.

sentences.zh: 及安死，莽乃以王車遣使者迎興、匡，封興為功修公，匡為功建公。

translations.literal: When An died, Mang then sent envoys with the king's carriage to welcome Xing and Kuang; Xing was enfeoffed Duke of Meritorious Cultivation, Kuang Duke of Meritorious Establishment.
translations.idiomatic: When An died, Wang Mang sent envoys with the royal carriage to welcome Xing and Kuang; Xing was enfeoffed as Duke of Meritorious Cultivation and Kuang as Duke of Meritorious Establishment.

sentences.zh: 卜者王況謂魏成大尹李焉曰：「漢家當復興，李氏為輔。

translations.literal: Diviner Wang Kuang said to Wei Commandery's Grand Administrator Li Yan: "The House of Han is to be restored; the Li clan will assist.
translations.idiomatic: The diviner Wang Kuang told Wei Commandery's grand administrator Li Yan, "The House of Han is to be restored, and the Li clan will assist."

sentences.zh: 」因為焉作讖書，合十餘萬言。

translations.literal: " He thereupon composed prophetic books for Yan, totaling more than a hundred thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon composed prophetic books for Li Yan, totaling more than a hundred thousand words.

sentences.zh: 事發，莽皆殺之。

translations.literal: When the affair was exposed, Mang executed them all.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was exposed, Wang Mang executed them all.

sentences.zh: 莽遣太師羲仲景尚、更始將軍護軍王黨將兵擊青、徐賊，國師和仲曹放助郭興擊句町，皆不能克。

translations.literal: Mang sent Grand Preceptor Yi Zhong Jing Shang and Gengshi General Protector of the Army Wang Dang with troops to strike the bandits of Qing and Xu; Director of the State He Zhong Cao Fang aided Guo Xing in striking Gouding—all could not overcome.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent Grand Preceptor Jing Shang of Yi Zhong and Gengshi General Wang Dang with troops against the bandits of Qing and Xu, and Director of the State Cao Fang aided Guo Xing against Gouding—all failed to prevail.

sentences.zh: 軍師放縱，百姓重困。

translations.literal: The army commanders were indulgent and lax; the common people were again distressed.
translations.idiomatic: The army commanders were indulgent and lax, and the common people were again in distress.

sentences.zh: 莽又轉天下穀帛詣西河、五原、朔方、漁陽，每一郡以百萬數，欲以擊匈奴。

translations.literal: Mang again transported grain and cloth from all under Heaven to Xihe, Wuyuan, Shuofang, and Yuyang—each commandery in sums of a million—intending to strike the Xiongnu.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang again transported grain and cloth from across the realm to Xihe, Wuyuan, Shuofang, and Yuyang, each commandery receiving sums in the millions, intending to attack the Xiongnu.

sentences.zh: 須卜當病死，莽以庶女妻其子後安公奢，所以尊寵之甚厚，終為欲出兵立之者。

translations.literal: Xubu Dang died of illness; Mang married a common-born daughter to his son Posterior Lord of Peace She—thereby honoring and favoring him very richly, ultimately because he wished to raise troops and establish him.
translations.idiomatic: Xubu Dang died of illness; Wang Mang married a lesser daughter to his son Posterior Lord of Peace She, thereby honoring him very richly, ultimately because he wished to raise troops and establish him.

sentences.zh: 會莽敗，雲、奢亦死。

translations.literal: When Mang fell, Yun and She also died.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Mang fell, Yun and She also died.

sentences.zh: 秋，隕霜殺菽，關東大饑，蝗。

translations.literal: In autumn, falling frost killed beans; east of the passes there was great famine and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, falling frost killed the beans; east of the passes there was great famine and locusts.

sentences.zh: 莽既輕私鑄錢之法，犯者愈眾，及伍人相坐，沒入為官奴婢。

translations.literal: Since Mang had lightened the law on private casting, offenders grew ever more numerous; mutual-responsibility groups were implicated and confiscated as official slave girls.
translations.idiomatic: Since Wang Mang had lightened the law on private coining, offenders grew ever more numerous, and mutual-responsibility groups were implicated and confiscated as government slaves.

sentences.zh: 其男子檻車，女子步，以鐵瑣琅當其頸，傳詣長安鐘官以十萬數。

translations.literal: The men were in caged carts, the women on foot, iron chains and manacles on their necks, conveyed to Chang'an's Bell Office in numbers of a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The men were sent in caged carts, the women on foot, iron chains and manacles on their necks, conveyed to Chang'an's Bell Office in numbers reaching a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 到者易其夫婦。

translations.literal: On arrival their husbands and wives were exchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival their husbands and wives were exchanged.

sentences.zh: 愁苦死者什六七。

translations.literal: From grief and hardship six or seven in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: From grief and hardship six or seven in ten died.

sentences.zh: 上谷儲夏自請說瓜田儀降之。

translations.literal: Shanggu's Chu Xia volunteered to persuade Guo Tian Yi to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Xia of Shanggu volunteered to persuade Guo Tian Yi to surrender.

sentences.zh: 儀未出而死，莽求其屍葬之，為起塚、祠室，謚曰瓜寧殤男。

translations.literal: Yi had not yet gone out when he died; Mang sought his corpse to bury it, raised a mound and shrine hall for him, and gave the posthumous title Lord Guaning, the Boy Who Died Young.
translations.idiomatic: Yi died before he could go out; Wang Mang sought his corpse to bury it, raised a mound and shrine for him, and gave the posthumous title Lord Guaning, the Boy Who Died Young.

sentences.zh: 閏月，丙辰，大赦。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on bingchen, a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingchen, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 郎陽成修獻符命，言繼立民母；

translations.literal: Gentleman Yangcheng Xiu presented a mandate-omen, saying to continue the establishment one should take the people's mother;
translations.idiomatic: Gentleman Yangcheng Xiu presented a mandate-omen, saying to continue the establishment one should take the people's mother;

sentences.zh: 又曰：「黃帝以百二十女致神仙。

translations.literal: it also said: "The Yellow Emperor attained immortality through a hundred twenty daughters.
translations.idiomatic: it also said, "The Yellow Emperor attained immortality through a hundred twenty daughters."

sentences.zh: 」莽於是遣中散大夫、謁者各四十五人，分行天下，博采鄉里所高有淑女者上名。

translations.literal: " Mang thereupon sent forty-five Palace Scribes and forty-five ushers each, traveling separately through the realm, broadly gathering from villages those of lofty virtue who were fair ladies and submitting their names.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang thereupon sent forty-five palace scribes and forty-five ushers each, traveling separately through the realm to gather from villages women of lofty virtue and fair character and submit their names.

sentences.zh: 莽惡漢高廟神靈，遣虎賁武士入高廟，拔劍四面提擊，斧壞戶牖，桃湯、赭鞭鞭灑屋壁，令輕車校尉居其中。

translations.literal: Mang hated the spirit of Gaozu's temple; he sent tiger-corps warriors into the High Temple, drew swords and struck on all four sides, broke doors and windows with axes, sprinkled peach broth and cinnabar whip on the walls, and ordered the colonel of light chariots to dwell within.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang hated the spirit of Emperor Gaozu's temple; he sent tiger-corps warriors into the High Temple to draw swords and strike on all four sides, broke doors and windows with axes, sprinkled peach broth and cinnabar whip on the walls, and ordered the colonel of light chariots to dwell within.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南郡秦豐聚眾且萬人；

translations.literal: That year Qin Feng of Nan commandery gathered a crowd of nearly ten thousand;
translations.idiomatic: That year Qin Feng of Nan commandery gathered a force of nearly ten thousand;

sentences.zh: 平原女子遲昭平亦聚數千人在河阻中。

translations.literal: the woman Chi Zhaoping of Pingyuan also gathered several thousand people in the river barrier lands.
translations.idiomatic: and Chi Zhaoping, a woman of Pingyuan, also gathered several thousand people in the river barrier lands.

sentences.zh: 莽召問群臣禽賊方略，皆曰：「此天囚行屍，命在漏刻。

translations.literal: Mang summoned and asked the ministers their strategy for capturing bandits; all said: "These are Heaven's prisoners, walking corpses—their fate hangs on the clepsydra's drip.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang summoned the ministers to ask their strategy for capturing the bandits; all said, "These are Heaven's prisoners, walking corpses—their fate hangs on the clepsydra's drip."

sentences.zh: 」故左將軍公孫祿徵來與議，祿曰：「太史令宗宣，典星曆，候氣變，以凶為吉，亂天文，誤朝廷；

translations.literal: " The former Left General Gongsun Lu was summoned to join the deliberation; Lu said: "Grand Astrologer Zong Xuan, who controls stars and calendars and watches qi changes, takes the ominous for auspicious, confuses Heaven's patterns, and misleads the court;
translations.idiomatic: " The former Left General Gongsun Lu was summoned to join the deliberation; Lu said, "Grand Astrologer Zong Xuan, who controls stars and calendars and watches qi changes, takes the ominous for auspicious, confuses Heaven's patterns, and misleads the court;"

sentences.zh: 太傅平化侯尊，飾虛偽以偷名位，賊夫人之子；

translations.literal: Grand Tutor Marquis of Pacification and Transformation Zun adorns falsehood to steal name and rank—a thief among gentlemen's sons;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Marquis of Pacification and Transformation Zun adorns falsehood to steal rank—a thief among gentlemen's sons;"

sentences.zh: 國師嘉信公秀，顛倒《五經》，毀師法，令學士疑惑；

translations.literal: Director of the State Duke of Assured Faith Xiu inverts the Five Classics, destroys the masters' methods, and leaves scholars in doubt;
translations.idiomatic: Director of the State Duke of Assured Faith Xiu inverts the Five Classics, destroys the masters' methods, and leaves scholars in doubt;"

sentences.zh: 明學男張邯、地理侯孫陽，造井田，使民棄土業；

translations.literal: Illustrious Learning Fellow Zhang Han and Marquis of Geography Sun Yang invented the well-field system and made the people abandon their land occupations;
translations.idiomatic: Illustrious Learning Fellow Zhang Han and Marquis of Geography Sun Yang invented the well-field system and made the people abandon their land occupations;"

sentences.zh: 羲和魯匡，設六筦以窮工商；

translations.literal: Director of Harmonization Lu Kuang established the six monopolies to exhaust merchants and artisans;
translations.idiomatic: Director of Harmonization Lu Kuang established the six monopolies to ruin merchants and artisans;"

sentences.zh: 說符侯崔發，阿諛取容，令下情不上通。

translations.literal: Marquis Who Explains Omens Cui Fa fawns and seeks favor, so that lower sentiments do not reach above.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Who Explains Omens Cui Fa fawns for favor, so that grievances below do not reach above."

sentences.zh: 宜誅此數子以慰天下！

translations.literal: These several men ought to be executed to comfort all under Heaven!"
translations.idiomatic: These men ought to be executed to comfort the realm!"

sentences.zh: 」又言：「匈奴不可攻，當與和親。

translations.literal: " He also said: "The Xiongnu cannot be attacked—one ought to make peace by marriage.
translations.idiomatic: " He also said, "The Xiongnu cannot be attacked—one ought to seek peace by marriage."

sentences.zh: 臣恐新室憂不在匈奴，而在封域之中也。

translations.literal: Your subject fears the New House's worry is not with the Xiongnu but within the sealed domain itself.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject fears the New House's worry lies not with the Xiongnu but within the realm itself."

sentences.zh: 」莽怒，使虎賁扶祿出，然頗采其言，左遷魯匡為五原卒正，以百姓怨誹故也。

translations.literal: " Mang was angry and had the tiger-corps support Lu out, yet he largely adopted his words, demoting Lu Kuang to Wuyuan company commander because the common people murmured resentment.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang was angry and had the tiger-corps escort Lu out, yet he largely adopted his words, demoting Lu Kuang to company commander of Wuyuan because the people murmured against him.

sentences.zh: 六筦非匡所獨造，莽厭眾意而出之。

translations.literal: The six monopolies were not Kuang's creation alone; Mang, weary of popular sentiment, removed him.
translations.idiomatic: The six monopolies were not Kuang's creation alone; Wang Mang, weary of popular sentiment, removed him.

sentences.zh: 初，四方皆以饑寒窮愁起為盜賊，稍稍群聚，常思歲熟得歸鄉里，眾雖萬數，不敢略有城邑，轉掠求食，日闋而已。

translations.literal: Initially the four directions all rose as bandits from hunger, cold, poverty, and distress; they gradually gathered in groups, always thinking that when the year ripened they could return to their villages—though their numbers reached tens of thousands, they dared not seize cities and towns, but turned to plundering for food and diminished day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Initially people everywhere rose as bandits from hunger, cold, poverty, and distress; they gradually gathered in groups, always thinking that when the harvest came they could return home—though their numbers reached tens of thousands, they dared not seize cities, but turned to plundering for food and dwindled day by day.

sentences.zh: 諸長吏牧守皆自亂鬥中兵而死，賊非敢欲殺之也，而莽終不諭其故。

translations.literal: The various chief officials, governors, and protectors all died in the chaos of fighting among their own troops—the bandits did not dare wish to kill them—but Mang to the end did not understand the reason.
translations.idiomatic: Various chief officials, governors, and protectors all died in the chaos of fighting among their own troops—the bandits did not dare wish to kill them—but Wang Mang to the end did not understand why.

sentences.zh: 是歲，荊州牧發奔命二萬人討綠林賊。

translations.literal: That year the Governor of Jing sent emergency troops of twenty thousand to suppress the Green Forest bandits.
translations.idiomatic: That year the governor of Jing dispatched twenty thousand emergency troops against the Green Forest bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊帥王匡等相率迎擊於雲杜，大破牧軍，殺數千人，盡獲輜重。

translations.literal: The bandit chiefs Wang Kuang and others together went to meet and strike at Yundu, greatly defeating the governor's army, killing several thousand, and taking all baggage and heavy equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit chiefs Wang Kuang and others met them at Yundu, routed the governor's army, killed several thousand, and seized all baggage and supplies.

sentences.zh: 牧欲北歸，賊馬武等復遮擊之，鉤牧車屏泥，刺殺其驂乘，然終不敢殺牧。

translations.literal: The governor wished to return north; the bandits Ma Wu and others again intercepted and struck, hooked the governor's carriage side-mudguard, stabbed and killed his outriders, yet in the end did not dare kill the governor.
translations.idiomatic: The governor wished to return north; Ma Wu and other bandits intercepted him again, hooked the mudguard of his carriage, stabbed and killed his outriders, yet in the end did not dare kill the governor.

sentences.zh: 賊遂攻拔竟陵，轉擊雲杜、安陸，多略婦女，還入綠林中，至有五萬餘口，州郡不能制。

translations.literal: The bandits then attacked and took Jingling, turned to strike Yundu and Anlu, seized many women, and returned into the Green Forests until they reached more than fifty thousand persons—the commanderies and province could not control them.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits then took Jingling, turned to strike Yundu and Anlu, seized many women, and returned to the Green Forest until they numbered more than fifty thousand—the commanderies and province could not control them.

sentences.zh: 又，大司馬士按章豫州，為賊所獲，賊送付縣。

translations.literal: Moreover a Grand Marshal clerk investigating documents in Yu Province was captured by bandits; the bandits sent him to the county.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover a clerk of the Grand Marshal investigating documents in Yu Province was captured by bandits, who sent him to the county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 士還，上書具言狀。

translations.literal: The clerk returned and memorialized, fully stating how things were.
translations.idiomatic: The clerk returned and memorialized, fully reporting what had happened.

sentences.zh: 莽大怒，下獄，以為誣罔，因下書責七公曰：「夫吏者，理也。

translations.literal: Mang was greatly angered, imprisoned him, deemed it false deception, and thereupon issued a document reproaching the Seven Ducal Ministers: "Officers are for ordering.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang was greatly angered, imprisoned him as a deceiver, and issued a document reproaching the Seven Ducal Ministers, "Officers exist to govern."

sentences.zh: 宣德明恩，以牧養民，仁之道也。

translations.literal: Spreading virtue and clarifying grace to shepherd and nurture the people is the Way of humaneness.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading virtue and clarifying grace to shepherd and nurture the people is the Way of humaneness.

sentences.zh: 抑強督奸，捕誅盜賊，義之節也。

translations.literal: Suppressing the strong and overseeing the crafty, capturing and executing bandits, is the integrity of righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Suppressing the strong and overseeing the crafty, capturing and executing bandits, is the integrity of righteousness.

sentences.zh: 今則不然。

translations.literal: Now it is not so.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is not so.

sentences.zh: 盜發不輒得，至成群黨遮略乘傳宰士。

translations.literal: When bandits arise they are not promptly taken; they reach forming gangs that intercept and plunder relay-carriage officials.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits arise they are not promptly captured; they form gangs that intercept and plunder relay-carriage officials.

sentences.zh: 士得脫者又妄自言：『我責數賊：「何故為是？

translations.literal: Clerks who escaped again falsely claimed: 'I reproached the bandits several times: "Why do you do this?"
translations.idiomatic: Clerks who escaped again falsely claimed, "I reproached the bandits: 'Why do you do this?"

sentences.zh: 」賊曰：「以貧窮故耳。

translations.literal: " The bandits said: "Because of poverty.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits said, "Because of poverty."

sentences.zh: 」賊護出我。

translations.literal: " The bandits protected and released me.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits protected me and let me go."

sentences.zh: 』今俗人議者率多若此。

translations.literal: ' Now vulgar commentators mostly speak like this.
translations.idiomatic: ' Now vulgar commentators mostly speak like this.

sentences.zh: 惟貧困饑寒犯法為非，大者群盜，小者偷穴，不過二科；

translations.literal: Only poverty, hunger, and cold break the law doing wrong—great ones band in groups, small ones steal and burrow—no more than two categories;
translations.idiomatic: Only poverty and hunger drive men to crime—great bands or petty theft, no more than two sorts;

sentences.zh: 今乃結謀連黨以千百數，是逆亂之大者，豈饑寒之謂邪！

translations.literal: Now they conspire and link factions by the hundreds and thousands—this is great rebellion—how can it be called hunger and cold!
translations.idiomatic: now they plot in factions of thousands—this is outright rebellion, not mere hunger and cold!

sentences.zh: 七公其嚴敕卿大夫、卒正、連率、庶尹，謹牧養善民，急捕殄盜賊！

translations.literal: The seven dukes should strictly order grandees, commandery chiefs, regional administrators, link-rates, and common supervisors—to carefully tend good people, urgently capture and exterminate bandits!
translations.idiomatic: Let the seven dukes strictly order every provincial chief to protect the good and exterminate bandits at once!

sentences.zh: 有不同心並力疾惡黠賊，而妄曰饑寒所為，輒捕繫，請其罪！

translations.literal: Whoever does not join hearts and strength to hate crafty bandits but rashly says it is hunger and cold's doing—immediately arrest and bind, and impeach his crime!
translations.idiomatic: Whoever shrinks from hunting bandits yet blames hunger and cold shall be seized and charged!

sentences.zh: 」於是群下愈恐，莫敢言賊情者，州郡又不得擅發兵，賊由是遂不制。

translations.literal: " Thereupon officials grew ever more fearful, none dared speak of bandit conditions; commanderies also could not on their own issue troops—bandits thereby became uncontrollable.
translations.idiomatic: " Officials grew terrified, none dared report bandit conditions, and commanderies could not raise troops on their own—bandits ran unchecked.

sentences.zh: 唯翼平連率田況素果敢，發民年十八以上四萬餘人，授以庫兵，與刻石為約。

translations.literal: Only Yiping link-rate Tian Kuang was by nature bold and resolute—raised people eighteen and above, more than forty thousand, armed them from the arsenal, and made a covenant carved in stone.
translations.idiomatic: Only Yiping link-rate Tian Kuang was bold by nature; he raised more than forty thousand men over eighteen, armed them from the arsenal, and carved their covenant in stone.

sentences.zh: 樊崇等聞之，不敢入界。

translations.literal: Fan Chong and others heard and did not dare enter his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Chong and his men heard of it and did not dare cross his border.

sentences.zh: 況自劾奏，莽讓況：「未賜虎符而擅發兵，此弄兵也，厥罪乏興。

translations.literal: Kuang impeached himself; Mang reproached Kuang: "Without being granted tiger tallies you presumptuously raised troops—this is toying with arms—the crime lacks full execution.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang impeached himself; Wang Mang reproached him: "You raised troops without tiger tallies—this is playing with arms—a crime that normally merits death.

sentences.zh: 以況自詭必禽滅賊，故且勿治。

translations.literal: Because Kuang himself declared he would surely capture and destroy bandits, for the time being do not punish.
translations.idiomatic: Because you vow to capture and destroy the bandits, we shall for the moment not punish you."

sentences.zh: 」後況自請出界擊賊，所向皆破。

translations.literal: " Later Kuang himself requested to go outside the border to strike bandits—wherever he went all were broken.
translations.idiomatic: " Later Kuang asked to campaign beyond his border; wherever he went he broke the enemy.

sentences.zh: 莽以璽書令況領青、徐二州牧事，況上言：「盜賊始發，其原甚微，部吏、伍人所能禽也。

translations.literal: Mang with a document bearing the seal ordered Kuang to take charge of Qing and Xu two provinces' governors' affairs; Kuang submitted: "When bandits first arise their source is very slight—district clerks and five-man squads can capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang ordered Kuang by sealed edict to oversee Qing and Xu provinces; Kuang memorialized: "When bandits first arise the trouble is slight—district clerks and five-man squads can catch them.

sentences.zh: 咎在長吏不為意，縣欺其郡，郡欺朝廷，實百言十，實千言百。

translations.literal: The fault lies in chief officials not taking heed—counties deceive their commandery, commanderies deceive the court—in substance a hundred words become ten, a thousand words become a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The fault lies with chief officials who ignore it—counties deceive commanderies, commanderies deceive the court—a hundred truths become ten, a thousand become a hundred.

sentences.zh: 朝廷忽略，不輒督責，遂至延蔓連州，乃遣將帥，多使者，傳相監趣。

translations.literal: The court overlooked and did not promptly supervise and reproach—then reaching spread across linked provinces—then sent generals, many envoys, relaying supervision and urging.
translations.idiomatic: The court overlooked it and did not promptly supervise; the plague spread across provinces—then generals were sent, many envoys relaying supervision and urging.

sentences.zh: 郡縣力事上官，應塞詰對，共酒食，具資用，以救斷斬，不暇復憂盜賊、治官事。

translations.literal: Commanderies and counties strained to serve superiors, answer interrogations, share wine and food, provide supplies to rescue those to be beheaded—no leisure again to worry over bandits or govern official affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Commanderies and counties strained to serve superiors, answer interrogations, share wine and food, and supply executions—no time left to worry over bandits or govern affairs.

sentences.zh: 將帥又不能躬率吏士，戰則為賊所破，吏氣浸傷，徒費百姓。

translations.literal: Generals also could not personally lead clerks and soldiers—in battle they were broken by bandits—officials' spirit gradually wounded, vainly exhausting the hundred surnames.
translations.idiomatic: Generals could not lead in person; in battle they were routed, official morale sank, and the people were wasted for nothing.

sentences.zh: 前幸蒙赦令，賊欲解散，或反遮擊，恐入山谷，轉相告語。

translations.literal: Before, having luckily received amnesty edicts, bandits wished to disperse—some again intercepted and struck—fearing to enter mountain valleys they turned and told one another.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier an amnesty had let bandits wish to disperse, but some were intercepted and struck; fearing traps in the hills, they warned one another.

sentences.zh: 故郡縣降賊皆更驚駭，恐見詐滅，因饑饉易動，旬日之間更十餘萬人，此盜賊所以多之故也。

translations.literal: Therefore commanderies and counties that surrendered to bandits were again startled and terrified, fearing to be tricked and destroyed—because of famine easily stirred—within ten days more than a hundred thousand again—this is why bandits are numerous.
translations.idiomatic: So surrendered counties were terrified anew, fearing treacherous slaughter; famine stirred them, and within ten days more than a hundred thousand joined—this is why bandits multiplied.

sentences.zh: 今洛陽以東，米石二千，竊見詔書欲遣太師、更始將軍。

translations.literal: Now east of Luoyang rice per shi is two thousand—I privately see the edict wishes to send the Grand Tutor and the General Who Initiates the New.
translations.idiomatic: East of Luoyang grain is two thousand cash per shi; I see the edict wishes to send the Grand Tutor and the General Who Initiates the New.

sentences.zh: 二人爪牙重臣，多從人眾，道上空竭，少則無以威示遠方。

translations.literal: The two are claws-and-teeth heavy ministers—with many followers the road is emptied—if few then no means to display awe to distant places.
translations.idiomatic: Both are trusted heavy ministers; with many followers the roads are emptied, yet with few there is no awe to show the distant regions.

sentences.zh: 宜急選牧、尹以下，明其賞罰，收合離鄉；

translations.literal: Should urgently select governors and supervisors downward, clarify rewards and punishments, gather those separated from villages;
translations.idiomatic: Urgently choose governors and supervisors, clarify rewards and punishments, and gather those scattered from their villages;

sentences.zh: 小國無城郭者，徙其老弱置大城中，積臧穀食，並力固守。

translations.literal: Small states without walls and moats—move their old and weak into great cities, store up hidden grain, combine strength to firmly defend.
translations.idiomatic: where small settlements lack walls, move the old and weak into great cities, store grain, and combine strength to hold firm.

sentences.zh: 賊來攻城，則不能下；

translations.literal: When bandits come to attack cities they cannot take them down;
translations.idiomatic: when bandits come to attack cities they cannot take them;

sentences.zh: 所過無食，勢不得群聚。

translations.literal: Where they pass there is no food—by force they cannot mass together.
translations.idiomatic: where they pass there is no food, and they cannot mass together.

sentences.zh: 如此，招之必降，擊之則滅。

translations.literal: Thus—summon them and they surely surrender, strike them and they are destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus summoned they will surely surrender; struck they will be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 今空復多出將帥，郡縣苦之，反甚於賊。

translations.literal: Now vainly again sending out many generals—commanderies and counties suffer it—worse than bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Now to send out more generals in vain will afflict the commanderies worse than the bandits.

sentences.zh: 宜盡徵還乘傳諸使者以休息郡縣。

translations.literal: Should fully recall all relay-messenger envoys to let commanderies and counties rest.
translations.idiomatic: Recall all relay envoys and let the commanderies rest.

sentences.zh: 委任臣況以二州盜賊，必平定之。

translations.literal: Entrust your subject Kuang with the two provinces' bandits—I will surely pacify them."
translations.idiomatic: Entrust me with the bandits of these two provinces—I will surely pacify them."

sentences.zh: 」莽畏惡況，陰為發代，遣使者賜況璽書。

translations.literal: " Mang feared and hated Kuang, secretly arranged a replacement, sent an envoy to grant Kuang a document with the seal.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang feared and hated Kuang, secretly arranged a replacement, and sent an envoy with a sealed edict.

sentences.zh: 使者至，見況，因令代監其兵，遣況西詣長安，拜為師尉大夫。

translations.literal: The envoy arrived, saw Kuang, and ordered someone else to supervise his troops in his stead, sent Kuang west to Chang'an, appointed Grandee for Master of Guards.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy arrived, saw Kuang, had another supervise his troops, sent Kuang west to Chang'an, and appointed him Grandee for Master of Guards.

sentences.zh: 況去，齊地遂敗。

translations.literal: Kuang departed—and Qi territory promptly fell.
translations.idiomatic: When Kuang left, Qi territory promptly collapsed.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，九廟成，納神主。

translations.literal: Spring, first month—the nine temples were completed, spirit tablets installed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, the nine temples were completed and the spirit tablets installed.

sentences.zh: 莽謁見，大駕乘六馬，以五采毛為龍文衣，著角，長三尺。

translations.literal: Mang paid homage—in the grand chariot riding six horses—with five-colored fur as dragon-pattern robes, wearing horns three feet long.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang paid homage in the grand chariot drawn by six horses, wearing dragon-pattern robes of five-colored fur and horns three feet long.

sentences.zh: 又造華蓋九重，高八丈一尺，載以四輪車。

translations.literal: He also made a nine-layered flowery canopy, eight zhang one chi high, carried on a four-wheeled cart.
translations.idiomatic: He also made a nine-tiered flowery canopy eight zhang one chi high, carried on a four-wheeled cart.

sentences.zh: 挽者皆呼「登仙」，莽出，令在前。

translations.literal: Those who pulled all cried "Ascend to immortals"—when Mang went out he had it go before.
translations.idiomatic: Those who pulled it all cried "Ascend to immortals"; when Wang Mang went out he had it go before.

sentences.zh: 百官竊言：「此似輀車，非仙物也。

translations.literal: The hundred officials whispered: "This resembles a funeral hearse—not an immortal's thing.
translations.idiomatic: The officials whispered: "This resembles a funeral hearse, not an immortal's conveyance."

sentences.zh: 二月，樊崇等殺景尚。

translations.literal: Second month—Fan Chong and others killed Jing Shang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Fan Chong and others killed Jing Shang.

sentences.zh: 關東人相食。

translations.literal: East of the Pass people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Pass people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，遣太師王匡、更始將軍廉丹東討眾賊。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month—sent Grand Tutor Wang Kuang and General Who Initiates the New Lian Dan east to campaign against the mass bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, he sent Grand Tutor Wang Kuang and General Who Initiates the New Lian Dan east against the mass bandits.

sentences.zh: 初，樊崇等眾既浸盛，乃相與為約：「殺人者死，傷人者償創。

translations.literal: At first when Fan Chong and others' host had gradually swelled, they made a covenant among themselves: "Killers die, wounders pay for wounds.
translations.idiomatic: At first, as Fan Chong's host swelled, they made a covenant: "Killers die; wounders pay for wounds."

sentences.zh: 」其中最尊號三老，次從事，次卒史。

translations.literal: " Among them the most honored was styled village elder, next attendant, next clerk.
translations.idiomatic: " Among them the most honored was styled village elder, next attendant, next clerk.

sentences.zh: 及聞太師、更始將討之，恐其眾與莽兵亂，乃皆朱其眉以相識別，由是號曰赤眉。

translations.literal: When they heard the Grand Tutor and General Who Initiates the New would campaign against them, fearing their masses would mix with Mang's soldiers, they all reddened their brows for mutual recognition—from this they were styled Red Eyebrows.
translations.idiomatic: When they heard the Grand Tutor and General Who Initiates the New would campaign against them, fearing their masses would mix with Wang Mang's troops, they all reddened their brows for recognition—from this they were called the Red Eyebrows.

sentences.zh: 匡、丹合將銳士十餘萬人，所過放縱。

translations.literal: Kuang and Dan together led crack troops more than a hundred thousand—wherever they passed they ran wild.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang and Dan together led more than a hundred thousand crack troops and ran wild wherever they passed.

sentences.zh: 東方為之語曰：「寧逢赤眉，不逢太師！

translations.literal: The east made a saying: "Better meet Red Eyebrows than meet the Grand Tutor!
translations.idiomatic: The east made a saying: "Better meet the Red Eyebrows than the Grand Tutor!

sentences.zh: 太師尚可，更始殺我！

translations.literal: The Grand Tutor is still tolerable—the General Who Initiates the New kills me!"
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor is still tolerable—the General Who Initiates the New kills me!"

sentences.zh: 」卒如田況之言。

translations.literal: " In the end it matched Tian Kuang's words exactly.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end it matched Tian Kuang's words exactly.

sentences.zh: 莽又多遣大夫、謁者分教民煮草木為酪，酪不可食，重為煩費。

translations.literal: Mang again sent many grandees and petitioners separately to teach the people to boil plants for cheeselike stuff—it could not be eaten, doubling the vexation and expense.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang again sent many grandees and petitioners to teach the people to boil plants into a cheeselike paste—it could not be eaten and doubled the vexation and expense.

sentences.zh: 綠林賊遇疾疫，死者且半，乃各分散引去。

translations.literal: Greenwood bandits met plague—dead nearly half—they each scattered and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Greenwood bandits met plague; nearly half died, and they each scattered and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 王常、成丹西入南郡，號「下江兵」；

translations.literal: Wang Chang and Cheng Dan west entered Nan commandery, styled "Lower Yangtze Army";
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chang and Cheng Dan went west into Nan commandery and styled themselves the Lower Yangtze Army;

sentences.zh: 王匡、王鳳、馬武及其支黨朱鮪、張卬等北入南陽，號「新市兵」。

translations.literal: Wang Kuang, Wang Feng, Ma Wu and their branch factions Zhu Wei, Zhang Ang and others north entered Nanyang, styled "New Market Army."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kuang, Wang Feng, Ma Wu, and their factions Zhu Wei, Zhang Ang, and others went north into Nanyang and styled themselves the New Market Army.

sentences.zh: 皆自稱將軍。

translations.literal: All styled themselves generals.
translations.idiomatic: All styled themselves generals.

sentences.zh: 莽遣司命大將軍孫仁部豫州，納言大將軍嚴尤、秩宗大將軍陳茂擊荊州，各從吏士百餘人，乘傳到部募士。

translations.literal: Mang sent Fate-Master Grand General Sun Ren to station in Yu Province, Present-Words Grand General Yan You and Rank-and-Rites Grand General Chen Mao to strike Jing Province—each with more than a hundred clerks and soldiers, riding relays to their posts to enlist troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent Fate-Master Grand General Sun Ren to station in Yu Province and Present-Words Grand General Yan You and Rank-and-Rites Grand General Chen Mao to strike Jing Province—each with more than a hundred followers, riding relays to their posts to enlist troops.

sentences.zh: 尤謂茂曰：「遣將不與兵符，必先請而後動，是猶紲韓盧而責之獲也。

translations.literal: You said to Mao: "To send a general without giving military tallies, requiring request before movement—is like tying up a Korean hound and charging it to catch game.
translations.idiomatic: You said to Mao, "To send a general without military tallies, requiring permission before action, is like tying up a Korean hound and charging it to catch game."

sentences.zh: 蝗從東方來，飛蔽天。

translations.literal: Locusts came from the east, flying and covering the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts came from the east, flying until they covered the sky.

sentences.zh: 流民入關者數十萬人，乃置養贍官稟食之，使者監領，與小吏共盜其稟，饑死者什七八。

translations.literal: Wandering people entering the passes numbered hundreds of thousands—he set up nurturing-support officials to distribute grain—envoys supervised, together with petty clerks stole the rations—starved dead seven or eight in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Hundreds of thousands of wanderers entered the passes; he set up relief officials to distribute grain, but envoys and petty clerks stole the rations together—seven or eight in ten starved to death.

sentences.zh: 先是，莽使中黃門王業領長安市買，賤取於民，民甚患之。

translations.literal: Earlier Mang had palace eunuch Wang Ye oversee Chang'an market buying—buying cheap from the people—the people greatly resented it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Mang had palace eunuch Wang Ye oversee Chang'an market purchases, buying cheap from the people, who greatly resented it.

sentences.zh: 業以省費為功，賜爵附城。

translations.literal: Ye took saving expense as merit—was granted the rank Attached-to-the-Wall.
translations.idiomatic: Ye took saving expense as merit and was granted the rank Attached-to-the-Wall.

sentences.zh: 莽聞城中饑饉，以問業。

translations.literal: Mang heard famine in the city and asked Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang heard of famine in the city and asked Ye.

sentences.zh: 業曰：「皆流民也。

translations.literal: Ye said: "All are wandering people.
translations.idiomatic: Ye said, "All are wanderers."

sentences.zh: 」乃市所賣粱飯、肉羹，持入示莽曰：「居民食咸如此。

translations.literal: " He then bought from the market grain rice and meat broth, brought them in to show Mang: "Residents' food is all like this.
translations.idiomatic: " He then bought grain rice and meat broth from the market, brought them in to show Wang Mang, and said, "Residents eat all like this."

sentences.zh: 」莽信之。

translations.literal: " Mang believed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Mang believed him.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，新市賊王匡等進攻隨；

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month—New Market bandits Wang Kuang and others advanced to attack Sui;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, New Market bandits Wang Kuang and others advanced to attack Sui;

sentences.zh: 平林人陳牧、廖湛復聚眾千餘人，號「平林兵」，以應之。

translations.literal: Pinglin men Chen Mu and Liao Zhan again gathered a crowd of more than a thousand, styled "Pinglin Army," to respond.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglin men Chen Mu and Liao Zhan again gathered more than a thousand men, styled the Pinglin Army, to respond.

sentences.zh: 莽詔書讓廉丹曰：「倉廩盡矣，府庫空矣，可以怒矣，可以戰矣！

translations.literal: Mang's edict reproached Lian Dan: "Granaries are exhausted, treasuries empty—you may rage, you may fight!
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang's edict reproached Lian Dan: "Granaries are exhausted and treasuries empty—you may rage, you may fight!

sentences.zh: 將軍受國重任，不捐身於中野，無以報恩塞責！

translations.literal: General, you bear the state's heavy charge—if you do not give your body on the central plain, no means to repay favor and block responsibility!"
translations.idiomatic: General, you bear the state's heavy charge—if you do not give your body on the central plain, you cannot repay favor or discharge your duty!"

sentences.zh: 」丹惶恐，夜，召其掾馮衍，以書示之。

translations.literal: " Dan was terrified; at night he summoned his aide Feng Yan and showed him the document.
translations.idiomatic: " Dan was terrified; at night he summoned his aide Feng Yan and showed him the document.

sentences.zh: 衍因說丹曰：「張良以五世相韓，椎秦始皇博浪之中。

translations.literal: Yan thereupon persuaded Dan: "Zhang Liang with five generations as Han chancellors clubbed Qin Shi Huang at Bolang—
translations.idiomatic: Yan thereupon persuaded Dan: "Zhang Liang, with five generations as Han chancellors, struck Qin Shi Huang at Bolang—

sentences.zh: 將軍之先，為漢信臣；

translations.literal: your general's forebears were Han's trusted ministers;
translations.idiomatic: your forebears were Han's trusted ministers;

sentences.zh: 新室之興，英俊不附。

translations.literal: when the New House rose, heroes did not attach.
translations.idiomatic: when the New House rose, heroes did not attach.

sentences.zh: 今海內潰亂，人懷漢德，甚於詩人思召公也；

translations.literal: Now within the seas collapses in chaos—people cherish Han's virtue more than poets missed Duke Shao;
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm collapses in chaos; people cherish Han's virtue more than poets missed Duke Shao;

sentences.zh: 人所歌舞，天必從之。

translations.literal: what men sing in chorus Heaven surely follows.
translations.idiomatic: what men sing in chorus Heaven surely follows.

sentences.zh: 方今為將軍計，莫若屯據大郡，鎮撫吏士，砥厲其節，納雄桀之士，詢忠智之謀，興社稷之利，除萬人之害，則福祿流於無窮，功烈著於不滅。

translations.literal: For the general's plan now, nothing better than encamping in a great commandery, pacifying clerks and soldiers, whetting their integrity, taking in heroic talents, seeking loyal and wise counsel, advancing the state's benefit, removing the myriad people's harm—then blessings flow without end, merit recorded unperishing.
translations.idiomatic: For your plan now, nothing better than encamping in a great commandery, pacifying clerks and soldiers, whetting their integrity, taking in heroic talents, seeking loyal and wise counsel, advancing the state's benefit, and removing the people's harm—then blessings flow without end and merit stands unperishing.

sentences.zh: 何與軍覆於中原，身膏於草野，功敗名喪，恥及先祖哉！

translations.literal: Why join an army destroyed in the central plain, body greasing the wild grass, merit failed and name ruined, shame reaching forefathers!
translations.idiomatic: Why join an army destroyed in the central plain, body greasing the wild grass, merit failed and name ruined, shame reaching your forefathers!

sentences.zh: 」丹不聽。

translations.literal: " Dan would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: " Dan would not listen.

sentences.zh: 衍，左將軍奉世曾孫也。

translations.literal: Yan was the left general Feng Shi's great-grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was the great-grandson of Left General Feng Shi.

sentences.zh: 冬，無鹽索盧恢等舉兵反城附賊，廉丹、王匡攻拔之，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: Winter—Wuyan Suolu Hui and others raised troops, rebelled cities and attached to bandits; Lian Dan and Wang Kuang attacked and took them, beheaded more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In winter Suolu Hui of Wuyan and others raised troops, rebelled cities, and joined the bandits; Lian Dan and Wang Kuang attacked and took them, beheading more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 莽遣中郎將奉璽書勞丹、匡，進爵為公；

translations.literal: Mang sent a palace gentleman with a document bearing the seal to comfort Dan and Kuang, advanced their rank to duke;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mang sent a palace gentleman with a sealed edict to comfort Dan and Kuang and advanced their rank to duke;

sentences.zh: 封吏士有功者十餘人。

translations.literal: enfeoffed more than ten clerks and soldiers who had merit.
translations.idiomatic: and enfeoffed more than ten meritorious clerks and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 赤眉別校董憲等眾數萬人在梁郡，王匡欲進擊之。

translations.literal: Red Eyebrow branch colonel Dong Xian and others—a host of tens of thousands in Liang commandery—Wang Kuang wished to advance and strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Red Eyebrow branch colonel Dong Xian and others—a host of tens of thousands in Liang commandery—Wang Kuang wished to advance and strike them.

sentences.zh: 廉丹以為新拔城罷勞，當且休士養威。

translations.literal: Lian Dan thought having newly taken cities the troops were weary—should for a time rest soldiers and nurture awe.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Dan thought that having newly taken cities the troops were weary and should rest and nurture their awe.

sentences.zh: 匡不聽，引兵獨進，丹隨之。

translations.literal: Kuang would not listen, led troops alone forward, Dan followed.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang would not listen, led troops forward alone, and Dan followed.

sentences.zh: 合戰成昌，兵敗，匡走。

translations.literal: Joined battle at Chengchang—army defeated—Kuang fled.
translations.idiomatic: They joined battle at Chengchang; the army was defeated and Kuang fled.

sentences.zh: 丹使吏持其印、□、節付匡曰：「小兒可走，吾不可！

translations.literal: Dan ordered a clerk to take his seal, [lacuna], and credential and hand them to Kuang: "The boy may run—I cannot!
translations.idiomatic: Dan ordered a clerk to hand Kuang his seal, [lacuna], and credential and said, "The boy may run—I cannot!

sentences.zh: 」遂止，戰死。

translations.literal: " He then stopped and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: " He then halted and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 校尉汝雲、王隆等二十餘人別鬥，聞之，皆曰：「廉公已死，吾誰為生！

translations.literal: Colonels Ru Yun, Wang Long and more than twenty fought separately—hearing it all said: "Lord Lian is dead—whom would I live for!
translations.idiomatic: Colonels Ru Yun, Wang Long, and more than twenty fought separately; hearing it, all said, "Lord Lian is dead—for whom would I live!

sentences.zh: 」馳奔賊，皆戰死。

translations.literal: " They galloped at the bandits and all died fighting.
translations.idiomatic: " They galloped at the bandits and all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 國將哀章自請願平山東，莽遣章馳東與太師匡並力。

translations.literal: State General Ai Zhang himself requested wish to pacify Shandong—Mang sent Zhang galloping east to join Grand Tutor Kuang's strength.
translations.idiomatic: State General Ai Zhang volunteered to pacify Shandong; Wang Mang sent Zhang galloping east to join Grand Tutor Kuang.

sentences.zh: 又遣大將軍陽浚守敖倉；

translations.literal: Also sent Grand General Yang Jun to guard Aocang;
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Grand General Yang Jun to guard Aocang;

sentences.zh: 司徒王尋將十餘萬屯洛陽，鎮南宮；

translations.literal: Minister of the Masses Wang Xun led more than a hundred thousand encamped at Luoyang, garrisoning Southern Palace;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of the Masses Wang Xun led more than a hundred thousand to encamp at Luoyang and garrison the Southern Palace;

sentences.zh: 大司馬董忠養士習射中軍北壘。

translations.literal: Grand Marshal Dong Zhong trained soldiers in archery at the central army's northern rampart.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Dong Zhong trained soldiers in archery at the central army's northern rampart.

sentences.zh: 大司空王邑兼三公之職。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi held all three top offices' duties.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Works Wang Yi held all three top offices' duties.

sentences.zh: 初，長沙定王發生舂陵節侯買，買生戴侯熊渠，熊渠生考侯仁。

translations.literal: At first Changsha's Stabilizing King Fa begat Chungling's Marquis of Integrity Mai, Mai begat Marquis Who Bears the Headdress Xiong Qu, Xiong Qu begat Marquis for Examination Ren.
translations.idiomatic: At first Changsha's Stabilizing King Fa begat Chungling's Marquis of Integrity Mai; Mai begat Marquis Who Bears the Headdress Xiong Qu; Xiong Qu begat Marquis for Examination Ren.

sentences.zh: 仁以南方卑濕，徙封南陽之白水鄉，與宗族往家焉。

translations.literal: Ren because the south was low and damp was moved enfeoffment to Nanyang's Baishui township, went with the clan to make their home there.
translations.idiomatic: Ren, because the south was low and damp, was moved to enfeoffment at Nanyang's Baishui township and went with the clan to settle there.

sentences.zh: 仁卒，子敞嗣；

translations.literal: Ren died, son Chang succeeded;
translations.idiomatic: Ren died and his son Chang succeeded;

sentences.zh: 值莽篡位，國除。

translations.literal: when Mang usurped the throne the state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: when Wang Mang usurped the throne the state was abolished.

sentences.zh: 節侯少子外為鬱林太守，外生巨鹿都尉回，回生南頓令欽。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Integrity's younger son Wai was Governor of Yulin, Wai begat Julu commandery commandant Hui, Hui begat Nandun magistrate Qin.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Integrity's younger son Wai was governor of Yulin; Wai begat Julu commandery commandant Hui; Hui begat Nandun magistrate Qin.

sentences.zh: 欽娶湖陽樊重女，生三男：縯，仲，秀，兄弟早孤，養於叔父良。

translations.literal: Qin married Huyang Fan Chong's daughter, bore three sons: Yan, Zhong, Xiu—the brothers early orphaned, raised by uncle Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Qin married Huyang Fan Chong's daughter and bore three sons: Yan, Zhong, and Xiu; the brothers were orphaned early and raised by their uncle Liang.

sentences.zh: 縯性剛毅，慷慨有大節，自莽篡漢，常憤憤，懷復社稷之慮，不事家人居業，傾身破產，交結天下雄俊。

translations.literal: Yan was by nature firm and resolute, generous with great integrity—since Mang usurped Han he was constantly indignant, harbored thoughts of restoring the altars and state, did not attend to family household business, poured himself out and ruined his estate, befriended heroes under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was firm and resolute, generous with great integrity; since Wang Mang usurped Han he was constantly indignant, harbored thoughts of restoring the altars and state, neglected family business, poured out his estate, and befriended heroes under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 秀隆准日角，性勤稼穡。

translations.literal: Xiu had high nose and sun-corner forehead, by nature diligent at farming.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu had a high nose and sun-corner forehead and was by nature diligent at farming.

sentences.zh: 縯常非笑之，比於高祖兄仲。

translations.literal: Yan often derided and laughed at him, comparing him to the Founder's elder brother Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Yan often derided him, comparing him to the Founder's elder brother Zhong.

sentences.zh: 秀姊元為新野鄧晨妻，秀嘗與晨俱過穰人蔡少公，少公頗學圖讖，言「劉秀當為天子」。

translations.literal: Xiu's elder sister Yuan was wife of Xinye's Deng Chen; Xiu once with Chen together passed Rang man Cai Shaogong—Shaogong had studied prognostic charts, saying "Liu Xiu will become Son of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Xiu's elder sister Yuan was wife of Xinye's Deng Chen; Xiu once passed with Chen by Rang man Cai Shaogong, who had studied prognostic charts and said, "Liu Xiu will become Son of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 或曰：「是國師公劉秀乎？

translations.literal: Someone said: "Is that State Mentor Duke Liu Xiu?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "Is that State Mentor Duke Liu Xiu?"

sentences.zh: 」秀戲曰：「何用知非僕邪？

translations.literal: " Liu Xiu jested: "What use to know it is not this servant?"
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiu jested, "What makes you so sure it is not this humble one?"

sentences.zh: 」坐者皆大笑，晨心獨喜。

translations.literal: " Those seated all laughed greatly; Chen alone was secretly pleased at heart.
translations.idiomatic: Those seated all laughed heartily; only Deng Chen was secretly pleased.

sentences.zh: 宛人李守，好星曆、讖記，為莽宗卿師。

translations.literal: Li Shou of Wan, fond of star calendars and omen records, was instructor to Mang's clan princes.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shou of Wan, fond of astronomy and omen texts, was instructor to Wang Mang's clan princes.

sentences.zh: 嘗謂其子通曰：「劉氏當興，李氏為輔。

translations.literal: He once told his son Tong: "The Liu house shall rise; the Li house shall assist.
translations.idiomatic: He once told his son Tong, "The Liu house shall rise; the Li house shall assist."

sentences.zh: 」及新市、平林兵起，南陽騷動，通從弟軼謂通曰：「今四方擾亂，漢當復興。

translations.literal: " When the Xinshi and Pinglin forces rose and Nanyang was disturbed, Tong's cousin Yi said to Tong: "Now the four quarters are in turmoil—Han ought to be restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xinshi and Pinglin forces rose and Nanyang was in turmoil, Tong's cousin Yi said to Tong, "The four quarters are in turmoil—Han ought to be restored."

sentences.zh: 南陽宗室，獨劉伯升兄弟泛愛容眾，可與謀大事。

translations.literal: Among Nanyang's imperial clansmen, only Bo Sheng Liu Yan and his brothers are broadly loving and accommodate the masses—they can be consulted on a great affair.
translations.idiomatic: Among Nanyang's imperial clansmen, only Bo Sheng Liu Yan and his brothers are broadly loving and accommodate the masses—they can be consulted on a great affair."

sentences.zh: 」通笑曰：「吾意也！

translations.literal: " Tong laughed and said: "That is my thought too!
translations.idiomatic: Tong laughed and said, "That is my thought too!"

sentences.zh: 」會秀賣穀於宛，通遣軼往迎秀，與相見，因具言讖文事，與相約結，定謀議。

translations.literal: " It happened that Xiu was selling grain at Wan; Tong sent Yi to welcome Xiu, and when they met he fully explained the omen-text matters, pledged alliance with him, and fixed their plotting.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Liu Xiu was selling grain at Wan; Tong sent Yi to welcome him, and when they met he fully explained the omen-text matters, pledged alliance with him, and fixed their plans.

sentences.zh: 通欲以立秋材官都試騎士日，劫前隊大夫甄阜及屬正梁丘賜，因以號令大眾，傳軼與秀歸舂陵舉兵以相應。

translations.literal: Tong wished on Beginning of Autumn's day of material-officer commandery cavalry review to seize Front Column Grandee Zhen Fu and Subordinate Rectifier Liangqiu Ci, thereby to command the masses; he sent Yi and Xiu back to Chunling to raise troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: Tong intended on the day of Beginning of Autumn when the commandery reviewed its material-officer cavalry to seize Front Column Grandee Zhen Fu and Subordinate Rectifier Liangqiu Ci, thereby to command the masses; he sent Yi and Liu Xiu back to Chunling to raise troops in response.

sentences.zh: 於是縯召諸豪桀計議曰：「王莽暴虐，百姓分崩。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yan summoned the heroic stalwarts to deliberate, saying: "Wang Mang is brutal and tyrannical; the hundred surnames are splitting apart.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Liu Yan summoned the local heroes to deliberate, saying, "Wang Mang is brutal and tyrannical; the people are splitting apart."

sentences.zh: 今枯旱連年，兵革並起，此亦天亡之時，復高祖之業，定萬世之秋也！

translations.literal: Now drought has continued for years in a row and arms flare up everywhere—this is also the time Heaven destroys him; restore Gaozu's enterprise and fix the autumn of ten thousand generations!
translations.idiomatic: Drought has continued for years and arms flare up everywhere—this is Heaven's time to destroy him; restore Gaozu's enterprise and secure the realm for ten thousand generations!"

sentences.zh: 」眾皆然之。

translations.literal: " The crowd all assented.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd all assented.

sentences.zh: 於是分遣親客於諸縣起兵，縯自發舂陵子弟。

translations.literal: Thereupon they separately dispatched kin-guests to raise troops in the various counties; Yan himself raised the Chunling clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they separately dispatched kin and retainers to raise troops in the various counties; Liu Yan himself raised the Chunling clansmen.

sentences.zh: 諸家子弟恐懼，皆亡匿，曰；

translations.literal: The clansmen of the various families were afraid—all fled and hid, saying;
translations.idiomatic: The clansmen of the various families were afraid and all fled and hid, saying,

sentences.zh: 「伯升殺我！

translations.literal: "Bo Sheng will kill me!
translations.idiomatic: "Bo Sheng will kill me!"

sentences.zh: 」及見秀絳衣大冠，皆驚曰：「謹厚者亦復為之！

translations.literal: " When they saw Xiu in crimson robes and great cap, they all marveled: "Even the careful and honest one is doing it too!
translations.idiomatic: When they saw Liu Xiu in crimson robes and great cap, they all marveled, "Even the careful and honest one is doing it too!"

sentences.zh: 」乃稍自安。

translations.literal: " Then they gradually calmed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Then they gradually calmed themselves.

sentences.zh: 凡得子弟七八千人，部署賓客，自稱「柱天都部」。

translations.literal: In all they got seven or eight thousand clansmen, deployed the guest-retainers, and styled themselves "Pillar of Heaven Capital Division."
translations.idiomatic: In all they mustered seven or eight thousand clansmen, deployed their retainers, and styled themselves "Pillar of Heaven Capital Division."

sentences.zh: 秀時年二十八。

translations.literal: Xiu was then twenty-eight years old.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiu was then twenty-eight years old.

sentences.zh: 李通未發，事覺，亡走；

translations.literal: Li Tong had not yet set out when the affair was discovered; he fled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tong had not yet set out when the affair was discovered; he fled;

sentences.zh: 父守及家屬坐死者六十四人。

translations.literal: his father Shou and household dependents—sixty-four were condemned and died.
translations.idiomatic: his father Shou and household dependents—sixty-four were condemned and died.

sentences.zh: 縯使族人嘉招說新市、平林兵，與其帥王鳳、陳牧西擊長聚；

translations.literal: Yan sent his clansman Jia to recruit and persuade the Xinshi and Pinglin forces; with their commanders Wang Feng and Chen Mu they attacked west toward Changju;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan sent his clansman Jia to recruit the Xinshi and Pinglin forces; with their commanders Wang Feng and Chen Mu they attacked west toward Changju;

sentences.zh: 進屠唐子鄉，又殺湖陽尉。

translations.literal: they advanced, slaughtered Tangzi township, and again killed the Huayang commandant.
translations.idiomatic: they advanced, slaughtered Tangzi township, and again killed the Huayang commandant.

sentences.zh: 軍中分財物不均，眾恚恨，欲反攻諸劉。

translations.literal: In the army the division of goods was unequal; the masses resented it and wished to turn and attack the various Lius.
translations.idiomatic: In the army the division of spoils was unequal; the troops resented it and wished to turn and attack the various Lius.

sentences.zh: 秀斂宗人所得物，悉以與之，眾乃悅。

translations.literal: Xiu gathered what the clan members had obtained and gave it all to them; the masses then were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiu gathered what the clan members had obtained and gave it all to them; the troops then were pleased.

sentences.zh: 進拔棘陽，李軼、鄧晨皆將賓客來會。

translations.literal: They advanced and took Jiyang; Li Yi and Deng Chen both led guest-retainers to join the assembly.
translations.idiomatic: They advanced and took Jiyang; Li Yi and Deng Chen both led retainers to join the assembly.

sentences.zh: 嚴尤、陳茂破下江兵。

translations.literal: Yan You and Chen Mao defeated the Xiajiang forces.
translations.idiomatic: Yan You and Chen Mao defeated the Xiajiang forces.

sentences.zh: 成丹、王常、張卬等收散卒入蔞谿，略鐘、龍間，眾復振。

translations.literal: Cheng Dan, Wang Chang, Zhang Yang, and others gathered scattered soldiers, entered Louxi, raided between Zhong and Long, and their masses revived.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Dan, Wang Chang, Zhang Yang, and others gathered scattered troops, entered Louxi, raided between Zhong and Long, and their forces revived.

sentences.zh: 引軍與荊州牧戰於上唐，大破之。

translations.literal: They led the army against the Regional Governor of Jingzhou at Shangtang and routed him.
translations.idiomatic: They led the army against the Regional Governor of Jingzhou at Shangtang and routed him.

sentences.zh: 十一月，有星孛於張。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: a broom star appeared in the Zhang asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month a broom star appeared in the Zhang asterism.

sentences.zh: 劉縯欲進攻宛，至小長安聚，與甄阜、梁丘賜戰。

translations.literal: Liu Yan wished to advance and attack Wan; reaching the muster at Xiaochang'an, he fought Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan wished to advance and attack Wan; reaching the muster at Xiaochang'an, he fought Zhen Fu and Liangqiu Ci.

sentences.zh: 時天密霧，漢軍大敗。

translations.literal: At the time the sky was thick with fog; the Han army was greatly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The sky was thick with fog; the Han army was routed.

sentences.zh: 秀單馬走，遇女弟伯姬，與共騎而奔。

translations.literal: Xiu fled on a single horse, met his younger sister Bo Ji, and together they rode and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiu fled alone on horseback, met his younger sister Bo Ji, and together they rode and fled.

sentences.zh: 前行，復見姊元，趣令上馬，元以手揮曰：「行矣，不能相救，無為兩沒也！

translations.literal: Going forward he again saw his elder sister Yuan, urged her to mount, and Yuan waved her hand and said: "Go—I cannot be saved; do not let us both perish!
translations.idiomatic: Going forward he again saw his elder sister Yuan, urged her to mount, and Yuan waved her hand and said, "Go—I cannot be saved; do not let us both perish!"

sentences.zh: 」會追兵至，元及三女皆死，縯弟仲及宗從死者數十人。

translations.literal: " Pursuing troops arrived; Yuan and three daughters all died; Yan's younger brother Zhong and clansmen followers who died numbered several tens.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing troops arrived; Yuan and three daughters all died; Liu Yan's younger brother Zhong and clansmen followers who died numbered several tens.

sentences.zh: 縯復收會兵眾，還保棘陽。

translations.literal: Yan again gathered and mustered the army masses and returned to hold Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan again gathered his forces and returned to hold Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 阜、賜乘勝留輜重於藍鄉，引精兵十萬南度潢淳，臨沘水，阻兩川間為營，絕後橋，示無還心。

translations.literal: Fu and Ci, riding their victory, left baggage at Lanxiang, led a hundred thousand crack troops south across Huangchun, came to the Yi River, blocked the space between the two streams to make a camp, cut the rear bridge, and showed they had no mind to return.
translations.idiomatic: Fu and Ci, riding their victory, left baggage at Lanxiang, led a hundred thousand crack troops south across Huangchun, came to the Yi River, camped between the two streams, cut the rear bridge, and showed they had no mind to return.

sentences.zh: 新市、平林見漢兵數敗，阜、賜軍大至，各欲解去，縯甚患之。

translations.literal: The Xinshi and Pinglin, seeing the Han army repeatedly defeated and Fu and Ci's army greatly arrive, each wished to disband and leave; Yan was deeply troubled.
translations.idiomatic: The Xinshi and Pinglin, seeing the Han army repeatedly defeated and Fu and Ci's army arrive in force, each wished to disband and leave; Liu Yan was deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 會下江兵五千餘人至宜秋，褲縯即與秀及李通俱造其壁曰：「願見下江一賢將，議大事。

translations.literal: It happened that more than five thousand Xiajiang troops reached Yiqiu; Liu Yan at once with Xiu and Li Tong together went to their rampart and said: "We wish to see one worthy general of the Xiajiang and discuss a great affair.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that more than five thousand Xiajiang troops reached Yiqiu; Liu Yan at once went with Liu Xiu and Li Tong to their rampart and said, "We wish to see one worthy general of the Xiajiang and discuss a great affair."

sentences.zh: 」眾推王常。

translations.literal: " The masses pushed forward Wang Chang.
translations.idiomatic: The troops pushed forward Wang Chang.

sentences.zh: 縯見常，說以合從之利，常大悟曰：「王莽殘虐，百姓思漢。

translations.literal: Yan saw Chang and argued the profit of alliance; Chang greatly awakened and said: "Wang Mang is cruel and savage; the hundred surnames long for Han.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan saw Chang and argued the profit of alliance; Chang greatly awakened and said, "Wang Mang is cruel and savage; the people long for Han."

sentences.zh: 今劉氏復興，即真主也；

translations.literal: Now the Liu house revives—they are the true lord;
translations.idiomatic: Now the Liu house revives—they are the true lord;

sentences.zh: 誠思出身為用，輔成大功。

translations.literal: I truly wish to exert myself to be employed and assist in completing a great achievement.
translations.idiomatic: I truly wish to exert myself in their service and assist in completing a great achievement."

sentences.zh: 」縯曰：「如事成，豈敢獨饗之哉！

translations.literal: " Yan said: "If the affair succeeds, how would I dare enjoy it alone!
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan said, "If the affair succeeds, how would I dare enjoy it alone!"

sentences.zh: 」遂與常深相結而去。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he and Chang formed a deep bond and left.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he and Chang formed a deep bond and left.

sentences.zh: 常還，具為餘將成丹、張卬言之。

translations.literal: Chang returned and fully explained it to the other generals Cheng Dan and Zhang Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Chang returned and fully explained it to the other generals Cheng Dan and Zhang Yang.

sentences.zh: 丹、卬負其眾曰：「大丈夫既起，當各自為主，何故受人制乎！

translations.literal: Dan and Yang, relying on their masses, said: "A great man having risen ought each to be his own master—why accept another's control!
translations.idiomatic: Dan and Yang, relying on their troops, said, "A great man having risen ought each to be his own master—why accept another's control!"

sentences.zh: 」常乃徐曉說其將帥曰：「王莽苛酷，積失百姓之心，民之謳吟思漢，非一日也，故使吾屬因此得起。

translations.literal: " Chang then slowly explained and persuaded his commanders, saying: "Wang Mang is harsh and cruel, long heaping up the loss of the hundred surnames' hearts; the people's songs and sighs longing for Han are not of a single day—therefore it made our sort rise on this account.
translations.idiomatic: Chang then slowly explained and persuaded his commanders, saying, "Wang Mang is harsh and cruel and has long lost the people's hearts; the people's songs and sighs longing for Han are not of a single day—therefore it made our sort rise on this account.

sentences.zh: 夫民所怨者，天所去也；

translations.literal: What the people resent, Heaven casts off;
translations.idiomatic: What the people resent, Heaven casts off;

sentences.zh: 民所思者，天所與也。

translations.literal: what the people desire, Heaven gives.
translations.idiomatic: what the people desire, Heaven gives.

sentences.zh: 舉大事，必當下順民心，上合天意，功乃可成。

translations.literal: To raise a great affair one must certainly below accord with the people's hearts and above unite with Heaven's intent—only then can achievement be completed.
translations.idiomatic: To raise a great affair one must below accord with the people's hearts and above unite with Heaven's intent—only then can achievement be completed.

sentences.zh: 若負強恃勇，觸情恣欲，雖得天下，必復失之。

translations.literal: If one relies on strength and presumes on courage, touches feeling and indulges desire—even obtaining all under Heaven, one will surely lose it again.
translations.idiomatic: If one relies on strength and presumes on courage, indulges feeling and desire—even obtaining all under Heaven, one will surely lose it again.

sentences.zh: 以秦、項之勢，尚至夷覆，況今布衣相聚草澤，以此行之，滅亡之道也。

translations.literal: With Qin and Xiang Yu's power they still reached extinction—how much more now plain-clothed men gathering in marshes; acting by this is the path of destruction.
translations.idiomatic: With the power of Qin and Xiang Yu they still reached extinction—how much more now plain-clothed men gathering in the marshes; acting by this is the path of destruction.

sentences.zh: 今南陽諸劉舉宗起兵，觀其來議者，皆有深計大慮，王公之才，與之併合，必成大功，此天所以祐吾屬也！

translations.literal: Now the various Lius of Nanyang have raised their clans in arms; observing those who came to deliberate—they all have deep plans and great foresight, the talent of kings and dukes. Joining with them will surely complete a great achievement—this is how Heaven blesses our sort!
translations.idiomatic: Now the various Lius of Nanyang have raised their clans in arms; observing those who came to deliberate—they all have deep plans and great foresight, the talent of kings and dukes. Joining with them will surely complete a great achievement—this is how Heaven blesses our sort!"

sentences.zh: 」下江諸將雖屈強少識，然素敬常，乃皆謝曰：「無王將軍，吾屬幾陷於不義！

translations.literal: " The Xiajiang generals, though stubbornly strong and short on insight, yet had always respected Chang; they all then apologized: "Without General Wang, our sort would nearly have fallen into unrighteousness!
translations.idiomatic: The Xiajiang generals, though stubbornly strong and short on insight, yet had always respected Chang; they all then apologized, "Without General Wang, our sort would nearly have fallen into unrighteousness!"

sentences.zh: 」即引兵與漢軍及新市、平林合。

translations.literal: " Immediately they led troops and united with the Han army and the Xinshi and Pinglin.
translations.idiomatic: Immediately they led troops and united with the Han army and the Xinshi and Pinglin.

sentences.zh: 於是諸部齊心同力，銳氣益壯。

translations.literal: Thereupon the various divisions with one heart joined strength and their keen spirit grew daily bolder.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the various divisions united in purpose and their keen spirit grew daily bolder.

sentences.zh: 縯大饗軍士，設盟約，休卒三日，分為六部。

translations.literal: Yan greatly feasted the soldiers, set an oath alliance, rested the troops three days, and divided into six divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan greatly feasted the soldiers, set an oath alliance, rested the troops three days, and divided them into six divisions.

sentences.zh: 十二月，晦，潛師夜起，襲取藍鄉，盡獲其輜重。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the last day of the month: they secretly arose the army at night, raided and took Lanxiang, and completely obtained their baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the last day of the month, they secretly arose the army at night, raided and took Lanxiang, and completely obtained their baggage train.
